Election day is quickly approaching, and I expected to see more enthusiasm from fellow conservatives ready to defeat the radical mob once and for all. But the truth is, the response has been underwhelming.

Anyone with half a brain can figure out that if you demonize something for a long time, eventually people will attack it. And mail-in balloting has been heavily attacked for more than four years now by partisans who only care about winning and power, not our democracy. What happened in these three states -- plus the self-appointed vigilantes caught on video guarding drop boxes with their firearms and questioning voters -- was bound to happen.
This can't be what our democracy comes to, Team. RUSH $25 or more right now to protect mail-in ballots, increase voter participation, and make sure every vote counts in a few days and in our future elections! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=103024_4&amount=25]

Workers scoop burning ballots from a drop box in 2024. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/DropBoxFire_WashingtonState_2024_small%282%29.gif]
Yes, those are burning ballots in Washington state's 3rd congressional district , projected to be one of the tightest races in the country. But that's not all -- another drop box in Oregon and a mailbox in Arizona were also set on fire in the last few days in attempts to destroy mail-in ballots.
Clark County Auditor Greg Kimsey said it best: " It's heartbreaking. It's a direct attack on democracy ."
We don't know who those ballots were filled out for. We don't know which political party those voters belong to. But we do know these are now hundreds of voices whose votes won't be counted. All because of the vile lies and misinformation spread about mail-in ballots for political gain by sore losers who want to hold onto their power.

clean_body: Please read this full message Peter, At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do. First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record. And what's worse, they are doing it all because I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate. Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT. Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end. I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old. I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg. It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War. After the Army, I earned a Ph.D. in international relations before moving to Pittsburgh to start a career in business. I worked my way up to become the CEO of FreeMarkets, a successful tech startup that employed hundreds in Western Pennsylvania. I was then called to service again, this time in the highest levels of government as Under Secretary of Treasury and as Deputy National Security Advisor. Following this, I joined Bridgewater Associates, one of the largest, most successful investment firms in the world, which manages the pension plans of groups including teachers, firefighters and law enforcement. I have lived the American Dream, and I am running for Senate to bring my decades of experience and love for our country to fix our broken economy that is a direct result of policies supported by my opponent, who has spent 18 years in Washington with NOTHING to show for it. I knew getting into this race could mean things would get nasty, but it 's sad to see we've fallen so far that these media outlets like the New York Times and CNN are pushing the Democrats' baked narrative about my upbringing and my business record. I've opened myself and my family up to attacks from the left, and every day feels like a battle. But I'm no stranger to fighting for what is right and if we don 't elect leaders to go to DC to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it! Here's where I need your help, Peter. We need to combat these lies with the TRUTH about me. The Democrats are seeing the same polls you and I see. They know if Kamala Harris and Bob Casey lose Pennsylvania, they lose it ALL, and they are going to do WHATEVER IT TAKES to try and defeat me. I hate asking for money -- I'm not a career politician, and it's not in my nature -- but I have no choice but to ask if we're going to hit our fundraising goal for the final stretch of the campaign. Chuck Schumer and his allies are working overtime to obliterate my campaign. They have committed to spend whatever it takes to defeat me. body:
We're running on coffee and grassroots support until midnight tomorrow.
#
Hi,
If you follow me on social media, you probably know about my famous Wawa coffee runs by now (and the burning question everyone keeps asking about how I take my coffee!). Well, I've promised to reveal that answer after November 5th — but before then, we've got some important work to do.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241030-2?refcode=em20241030-1514&amount=5&refcode2=1514_21716_L86mf2&akid=1514%2E21716%2EL86mf2)
While I take a moment to take a coffee break, I wanted to reach out about something crucial: we're facing our**final end-of-month deadline** before Election Day, and we need your help to keep our momentum strong!
Here's the thing: while folks keep asking me about cream and sugar, they're also talking about the real issues — like our work on paid leave, investing in Medicaid, and passing the nation’s most robust anti-corruption laws. And with just days until November 5th, we need to reach as many voters as possible with our message.
We're still **$6,000** away from our end-of-month goal, and we have until midnight tomorrow, October 31st, to get there. **This isn't just another deadline — it's our _last chance_ to boost our grassroots outreach before Election Day.**
[**Can you chip in before midnight tomorrow to help us reach more voters in these final days?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241030-2?refcode=em20241030-1514&amount=5&refcode2=1514_21716_L86mf2&akid=1514%2E21716%2EL86mf2)

I'll be up late tomorrow night tracking our progress (with plenty of coffee, of course). I hope I can count on your support to help us finish October strong.
Thank you!
Sarah McBride

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
body:
Might be the most important email you read today
|
---

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=ed0248b717b84f24b2411f29f11ee0ff&_e=hYTS_uju2uAma9LC3sFS3JTr-umze85GVp7WBXtVoevHUDu2UKbVc2my7v0MgAsE249nAkXgmzTfnmJg-4Ipk0d3fWbwKEoxB1DVGyQZS85s8f_yJdWcwhyA0ywjLFYhC0zXfSYGU9HZZSY-1g2GIiTNkqujW_jAKhbF_xH6fGGvqkoLya17ZLeZV_o9K918YNfmtPs-q9MPlQVXXUIAiRKvbtyNTAxFJj4Kzq-PYqbaSFwhviTX7RP1WoUhpy91ugc7BixJ56135KtKywVQAywE3tMvNygWZdiBQaZrhzIVe25fmMjuci_hHHq_zovys4kZk7MgT9GzrHf_eY0Xpw%3D%3D)
Hey,

This is the first and last email I'll ever send you, Fellow American.

I'm a little anxious about opening up to you this way, but I've worked my entire life to overcome my anxiety, so here we are.

**It 's the fourth quarter, and the Dems are putting a full-court press on us. My back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything.**

My name is Royce White. You might not know me, but I'm a professional basketball player who saw huge success in college, got drafted to the NBA, and put it all behind me to fight for players' mental health policy. I left the NBA to play in Canada, and now play professionally in the BIG 3 Tournament.

**I 'm also the GOP Candidate in a MUST-WIN race for Minnesota's next United States Senator, a race that could decide who controls Washington, D.C.**

Joe Biden and Kamala Harris have already raised over $500 MILLION to trash GOP Candidates and cling to power. Money that will go directly to my liberal opponent, Amy Klobuchar.

[**That 's why I'm humbly asking if you'll chip in just a few bucks today.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=ed0248b717b84f24b2411f29f11ee0ff&_e=hYTS_uju2uAma9LC3sFS3JTr-umze85GVp7WBXtVoevHUDu2UKbVc2my7v0MgAsE249nAkXgmzTfnmJg-4Ipk0d3fWbwKEoxB1DVGyQZS85s8f_yJdWcwhyA0ywjLFYhC0zXfSYGU9HZZSY-1g2GIiTNkqujW_jAKhbF_xH6fGGvqkoLya17ZLeZV_o9K918EI-yUpOyOP9o6KiZ-gMm4ZeIzVzCK94t_m1jPjnfGXsyBQiZCV7DdQ_8PunmaCkf8M1tKBtj4Pv5ag72WbvWBZxozF653TiCb9vHl8Yk3Q-nPZj9-0wnzDO4syQhBDqP0hVJj2_JwM76ZZ4aJJkHxw%3D%3D)
The Industrial Media Complex thinks I can't win this race, but I bet you've heard that one before.

It's really hard to ask for help like this, but starting a grassroots campaign is incredibly difficult.

Biden, Harris, Walz, and Klobuchar won't stop pressing us. America-First Patriots like you and me - they hate us.

[**Will you please have my back on this one and pass me an assist?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=ed0248b717b84f24b2411f29f11ee0ff&_e=hYTS_uju2uAma9LC3sFS3JTr-umze85GVp7WBXtVoevHUDu2UKbVc2my7v0MgAsE249nAkXgmzTfnmJg-4Ipk0d3fWbwKEoxB1DVGyQZS85s8f_yJdWcwhyA0ywjLFYhC0zXfSYGU9HZZSY-1g2GIiTNkqujW_jAKhbF_xH6fGGvqkoLya17ZLeZV_o9K918yA3YuBQgdmCLsBkzDuvaW8ixBjBVGWWdgrNU4DyTa2TWPPlsay_bwnU3VZ6bY82EV1mIavU6LEbRyVDinvrIYUr1bqhy6ITqmEl8ZBHiySDgYebceBM8aMmLuz5KC-B0BuoHHdkYDLlcAOFj-SDsTQ%3D%3D)
| [ **RUSH YOUR SUPPORT** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=ed0248b717b84f24b2411f29f11ee0ff&_e=hYTS_uju2uAma9LC3sFS3JTr-umze85GVp7WBXtVoevHUDu2UKbVc2my7v0MgAsE249nAkXgmzTfnmJg-4Ipk0d3fWbwKEoxB1DVGyQZS85s8f_yJdWcwhyA0ywjLFYhC0zXfSYGU9HZZSY-1g2GIiTNkqujW_jAKhbF_xH6fGGvqkoLya17ZLeZV_o9K918Zds4w48iw8ck8V_rKRBkhGlRdV85VmyWr4dtFaNdZX3zQmKnzbl15MNmAk5PhbD_ydkWBupTXq1GTpdyo6d14NYtzfsChqR9REVIb4oq9ycQXMlggxgx9z36Ns4aqcKjaUayxrZ5fSzhjXgkf81BTg%3D%3D)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico on the issues of crime, education, and economic opportunity. | Friend, My new ad “Priorities” is my closing argument to the voters in New Mexico, Martin Heinrich has failed New Mexico on the issues of crime, education, and economic opportunity. My priorities as the next U.S. Senator are securing the border, bringing down costs, and improving education. All of this is laid out in this ad, and it’s vital that New Mexicans know the choice they’re faced with before Election Day. We have a week to win support before voters head to the polls. Thank you, Nella Domenici Republican for Senate P.S. We’re poised to make history and demonstrate that even in a presumed “blue state” like New Mexico, families and workers are sick and tired of the failed policies of the radical left. | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. October 30, 2024
Jim Himes, the incumbent Democrat squared off in a [debate ](https://substack.com/redirect/40a9a841-b1e4-4f40-8052-f847cf2dca17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)against his Republican opponent Dr. Michael Goldstein, and his Independent Party opponent Mr. Ben Wesley.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/482d55cf-2208-408e-93a2-08decd51619f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
From Left to Right: Jim Himes, Michael Goldstein and Ben Wesley
The debate was moderated by Mr. Gregory Stroud, editor of CTExaminer.com. Mr. Stroud restored my faith in journalism, asking relevant questions, not fact-checking the answers, keeping a sometimes-raucous audience under control and gently but firmly forcing the candidates to follow the time limits.
The debate was educational. Regardless of one's political views, a voter could watch this debate and make an informed choice on what candidate he or she preferred.
The debate began with Jim Himes coming out swinging, listing his accomplishments while attacking Dr. Goldstein for being a MAGA Republican who attended the Trump rally at Madison Square Garden.
Dr. Goldstein did not take the bait, but merely listed the disastrous results of policies enacted by the Biden administration that Jim Himes rubberstamped - inflation, crime, illegal immigration and traffic.
Mr. Wesley, an engineer from Norwalk, emphasized the need for a ceasefire in Gaza and believes Israel is being too harsh on Gaza's residents, a point Dr. Goldstein vigorously rebutted.
But it was Mr. Wesley who raised the most interesting issue that has not been discussed during this campaign season, the Ukraine War. Mr. Wesley thought it was ill-advised for the United States to be encouraging Ukraine to invade Russian territory pointing out this increases the chance of a nuclear war. He challenged Jim Himes to respond.
Jim Himes gave an erudite response and rattled off a list of sophisticated weapon systems required to defeat Russia that only a fellow member of the Intelligence Committee could fathom. But he never directly addressed Mr. Wesley's concerns:
Is our support of Ukraine invading Russian worth the risk of a nuclear war?
Isn't it reasonable that if Russia's territory is threatened by armaments we supply to Ukraine, that Russia could attack us?
As Mr. Wesley pointed out (and I paraphrase): "What is the point in having a debate about inflation, illegal immigration and housing prices if we are greatly increasing our chance of a nuclear war?"
Game, Set, Match Mr. Wesley.
The low point of the debate occurred when Dr. Goldstein was asked about illegal immigration in which he gave the standard Trumpian response that we must secure our borders and deport illegals involved in violent crime, sex trafficking and drug sales.
Jim Himes viciously responded by pointing out that Dr. Goldstein was accused of illegally dumping dirt to level the area around his swimming pool. Himes further asserted that Dr. Goldstein had used illegal immigrants to build his swimming pool and dump the dirt.
Most other candidates would have lost their cool by Dr. Goldstein just laughed and pointed out that [Greenwich had verbally](https://substack.com/redirect/d91330af-7589-426a-a2e9-989b4e0a77e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) agreed to allow him to dump this dirt but then changed their mind. He further pointed out that the swimming pool was thirty years old, and no illegal had ever worked on it. Then with another laugh, he pointed out that Democratic Governor Ned Lamont chopped down 200 trees without a permit and Himes said nothing about this.
Jim Himes looked like a fool.
But because of a coin toss, Jim Himes had the last word and with his face etched in anger, viciously attacked Dr. Goldstein stating:
"_You can only state that [Harris and Himes] are a risk to democracy if you are not truthful. ... His candidate [Trump] has called for a day of dictatorship, suspending the Constitution, has said that the media is [sic] the enemy of the people... Our Constitution is at risk by this abnegation and disdain... that is shown by Donald Trump and Michael Goldstein."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d7f4ad1d-e47e-4e4b-bb87-e23dbb76f23f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Jim Himes Viciously Attacking Dr. Michael Goldstein
I found this odd. I had never seen Congressman Himes in person but have seen him numerous times being interviewed on television. Dr. Goldstein and I watched his debate twice with his previous opponent Jamie Stevenson, the Republican nominee in 2022. He always seemed in control and not prone to hyperbole. After all, the Congressman is a Harvard educated Rhodes Scholar.
So why did he behave like this?
Maybe his internal polling shows that Dr. Goldstein is within striking distance. But Jim Himes has raised over $2,000,000 while Dr. Goldstein has raised around $50,000. Furthermore, Jim Himes has easily vanquished better financed and experienced opponents in the past - Dan Debicella, Steve Obsitnik and Harry Arora. And Fairfield County is Bluer now. Compound this with the fact that Donald Trump is at the top of the ticket and lost Fairfield County by 36% in 2020 - it would appear unlikely that he perceives Mike Goldstein as a threat to his seat.
So why the vitriol? Why not be gracious?
The answer is scary. Congressman Himes does not view Dr. Goldstein and Trump supporters as fellow Americans. He views them as "deplorables," like Hillary Clinton. He views them as "[garbage" as recently stated by President Biden](https://substack.com/redirect/3978675b-7b1b-4b7c-9b6d-266f50dfe24f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). You can see it in the anger on his face. And having elected officials despise those who disagree with them is dangerous for not only Fairfield County, but also the country.
Fairfield County would be much better served by a tolerant mensch like Mike Goldstein.

First, I heard the glass break. **Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son: "Whatever happens, I love you."** I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that. **But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – hid in a supply closet.** In just 20 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve. But after last night's debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. clean_body: | | | Peter, on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that overtook our Capitol on January 6. And what was his response? He laughed!! There's nothing funny about this, Peter. I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol. First, I heard the glass break. Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son: "Whatever happens, I love you." I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that. But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – hid in a supply closet. In just 20 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve. But after last night's debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. And the latest polling still shows this race locked neck and neck. He hasn’t made a career as a Washington insider - just the opposite. He’s an entrepreneur who built a successful business from the ground up.

This November, we’ve got a great map—unlike anything we’ve seen in a few decades—and with high-quality candidates like Bernie, I know we can win back the Republican majority in the Senate.

But here’s the bad news, Peter. _**Democrats like Sherrod Brown are outraising us by millions.**_

I’ve already transferred $4 million to help folks like Bernie, but he needs folks like you to step up to take on a 50-year career politician in Sherrod Brown.

Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Getting in formation to WIN
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20at%20Kamala%20-%20Beyonce%20rally.jpg]
TEXANS, we’re in the LAST week of early voting. HEAD TO THE POLLS. Early voting ends this Friday, Nov. 1. Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 5.
Grievances, racism, and misogyny. It's all Trump and MAGA have to offer. As Beyoncé so aptly stated at last week's Kamala Harris rally in Houston, "It’s time for America to sing a new song.” [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2024/oct/25/kamala-harris-donald-trump-us-election-politics-barack-obama]
We've BEEN ready. This election will shape our state and nation for years to come. We can’t just be on the sidelines. The candidates and local propositions we vote for at the municipal level shape our everyday lives and those of our families. As voters and community members, WE have the power to elect leaders committed to our values, progress, and a future where ALL Texans can thrive — no matter our age, race, income level, or ZIP Code.
TOP knows what’s at stake this election, and through our TOP PAC, BlackTOP, and non-partisan voter outreach efforts we are kicking our get-out-vote efforts into a higher gear with the finish line now in sight. See you at the polls!
- Access a full list of TOP-endorsed candidates committed to building a #TXForAll. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/]
- See what will be on your ballot at Vote411.org. [https://www.vote411.org/]
- Find early vote polling locations and hours in your county. [https://www.votetexas.gov/voting/where.html]
- Visit GoVoteTexas.org for acceptable forms of photo ID to bring with you to vote. [https://govotetexas.org/] (Don't forget it!)
P.S. — Drop by BlackTOP's Houston election watch party at Stuff'd Wings if you'll be in the area the night of November 5. Let’s celebrate our wins efforts! Get more details here and RSVP. [https://secure.everyaction.com/-QTLnRxK8E6mq_eFbh0Tpw2]
TEXAS & FLORIDA:
Linked Fates, Shared Power
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BlackTOP%20-%20Florida%20Rising%20-%20Instagram%20Live.jpg]
TOP's Brianna Brown connected with Florida Rising’s Executive Director Andrea Mercado this past Thursday, going live on BlackTOP’s Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/reel/DBhGK0WSyMJ/] , touching on the vibes of the presidential election, why our organizing is so vital, and how the political fates of Texas and Florida are intertwined. If you’re not on Instagram, no problem. Watch the convo on YouTube here. [https://youtu.be/b163B8j_8jo?si=W3cPrvgq-U5cYKvX]
Florida Rising [https://floridarising.org/] is a sister org. to TOP, doing in Florida what we’re doing in Texas: organizing communities to challenge systems of oppression and boldly transform our democracy for the better. Just as Texas has MAGA extremists in office, Florida is contending with their own far-right politicians who are determined to restrict freedoms – whether it’s attacking reproductive rights, undermining public education, or suppressing the right to vote.
Together, we're building a multi-state movement to fight these injustices and create a future where everyone’s voice is heard and valued – regardless of age, race, gender, preferred language, or where we call home.
JOIN US for part 2 this Friday at 2 p.m. on BlackTOP's Instagram Live , as TOP Board Co-President Dr. Doshie Piper and Florida Rising board member Delis Paula shed more light on this volatile political moment, and the multi-racial, working-class movement for progressive change our organizations are building toward.
LAST CALL: Take our survey!
Organizing for a more humane probation system in Bexar County
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bexar%20County%20Right2Justice.jpg]
Texas taxpayers are spending huge sums on an inefficient probation system each and every year. We need to reconsider the system to make it safe and effective, not costly and ineffective. More people are on probation in Texas than are serving time in every county jail — that's 254 counties put together and then multiplied by three. Mounting a statewide intervention to disrupt how probation works in Texas is yet another way we chip away at mass incarceration in our state.
TAKE THIS SURVEY if you're a Bexar County resident, to share with us your thoughts on the county's probation system. [https://secure.everyaction.com/Mshuu6fauEG23vOgLeWFfg2]
For more information about TOP’s Right2Justice work in Bexar County, contact Laquita Garcia at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tip: Head to your polling place with an acceptable form of ID to vote
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Voter%20ID%20Texas.jpg]
Reminder: To cast your ballot in Texas, whether its during early vote or on Election Day, you need an acceptable form of identification. We all lose or misplace forms of ID on occasion. Before you head to your polling place, double-check that you're covered to vote by checking out this Texas ID requirement list. [https://www.voteriders.org/states/texas/]
Español
Poniéndonos en formación para ganar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20at%20Kamala%20-%20Beyonce%20rally.jpg]
TEXANOS, estamos en la ÚLTIMA semana de votación anticipada. ACUDA A LAS URNAS. La votación anticipada termina este viernes 1 de noviembre. El día de las elecciones es el martes 5 de noviembre.
Quejas, racismo y misoginia. Es todo lo que Trump y MAGA tienen para ofrecer. Como dijo tan acertadamente Beyoncé en el mitin de Kamala Harris de la semana pasada en Houston: "Es hora de que Estados Unidos cante una nueva canción." [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2024/oct/25/kamala-harris-donald-trump-us-election-politics-barack-obama]
Estamos MÁS que listos. Esta elección dará forma a nuestro estado y nación por muchos años. No podemos quedarnos al margen. Los candidatos y las propuestas locales que votamos a nivel municipal moldean nuestra vida cotidiana y la de nuestras familias. Como votantes y miembros de la comunidad, TENEMOS el poder de elegir líderes comprometidos con nuestros valores, el progreso y un futuro donde TODOS los tejanos puedan prosperar — sin importar nuestra edad, raza, nivel de ingresos o código postal.
TOP sabe lo que está en juego en estas elecciones y, a través de nuestro TOP PAC, BlackTOP y esfuerzos de divulgación no partidistas, estamos impulsando nuestros esfuerzos de movilización de votos a una marcha más alta con la línea de meta ahora a la vista. ¡Nos vemos en las urnas!
- Acceda a una lista completa de candidatos respaldados por TOP comprometidos con la construcción de un #TXForAll. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/]
- Vea lo que estará en su boleta en Vote411.org. [https://www.vote411.org/]
- Encuentre los lugares y horarios de votación anticipada en su condado. [https://www.votetexas.gov/voting/where.html]
- Visite GoVoteTexas.org para obtener formas aceptables de identificación con foto para llevar contigo para votar. [http://govotetexas.org/] (¡No lo olvides!)
P.D. — Pásate por la fiesta de watch party de BlackTOP en Houston en Stuff’d Wings si estarás en la zona la noche del 5 de noviembre. ¡Celebremos nuestros logros y esfuerzos! Obtén más detalles aquí y confirma tu asistencia. [https://secure.everyaction.com/-QTLnRxK8E6mq_eFbh0Tpw2]
TEXAS Y FLORIDA:
Destinos vinculados, poder compartido
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BlackTOP%20-%20Florida%20Rising%20-%20Instagram%20Live.jpg]
Brianna Brown de TOP se conectó con Andrea Mercado, Directora Ejecutiva de Florida Rising, el pasado jueves en vivo en el Instagram de BlackTOP [https://www.instagram.com/reel/DBhGK0WSyMJ/] . Platicaron sobre el ambiente de las elecciones presidenciales, la importancia de nuestra organización y cómo los destinos políticos de Texas y Florida están entrelazados. Si no tienes Instagram, ¡no hay problema! Mira la conversación en YouTube aquí. [https://youtu.be/b163B8j_8jo?si=mFI1RuX-OddamuKe]
Florida Rising [https://floridarising.org/] es una organización hermana de TOP, que hace en Florida lo que estamos haciendo en Texas: organizar comunidades para desafiar los sistemas de opresión y transformar audazmente nuestra democracia para mejor. Así como Texas tiene extremistas MAGA en el poder, Florida está lidiando con sus propios políticos de extrema derecha que están decididos a restringir las libertades, ya sea atacando los derechos reproductivos, socavando la educación pública o suprimiendo el derecho al voto. [] - Find early vote polling locations and hours in your county. [] - Visit GoVoteTexas.org for acceptable forms of photo ID to bring with you to vote. [] (Don't forget it!) [] TEXAS & FLORIDA: Linked Fates, Shared Power [] TOP's Brianna Brown connected with Florida Rising’s Executive Director Andrea Mercado this past Thursday, going live on BlackTOP’s Instagram [] , touching on the vibes of the presidential election, why our organizing is so vital, and how the political fates of Texas and Florida are intertwined. If you’re not on Instagram, no problem. Watch the convo on YouTube here. [] Florida Rising [] is a sister org. to TOP, doing in Florida what we’re doing in Texas: organizing communities to challenge systems of oppression and boldly transform our democracy for the better. We need to reconsider the system to make it safe and effective, not costly and ineffective. More people are on probation in Texas than are serving time in every county jail — that's 254 counties put together and then multiplied by three. Mounting a statewide intervention to disrupt how probation works in Texas is yet another way we chip away at mass incarceration in our state. TAKE THIS SURVEY if you're a Bexar County resident, to share with us your thoughts on the county's probation system. subject: Hearing aids just got their biggest upgrade...
body:
Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zeoci83v4ts65m8jbqqoqoh4tcmn9a03hbibhd6g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cphmeo34c9h2bs)
---
| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z7lv6juip6nr8af9ujativ6icqdikdalhpmavs6g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cphmeo34c9h2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z5ahlilppi4fh07gthp0pg4orb0v7ui2hln9anuo_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cphmeo34c9h2bs)
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ztpad9p7h64v7bt9radq7vfvsgtaki4gsrftsqho_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cphmeo34c9h2bs)
What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

Limited no-risk trials now available

Click below to check if you qualify for a 45-day no-risk trial. As the Germans always say: "there's never been a better time." So do yourself a favor and don’t wait. **Get started today.**
[Check if you qualify](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zhb2gi5m9t4f1t3vs817mfh1jjn8m0iqj5tcgk3g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cphmeo34c9h2bs)

body:
Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z10eb58pm0sjj83du73fotfdmcntkuk2r2t47vro_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cphm1o72cjh2bs)
---
| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zd7dqqamsui7hpl3taa85tkv968lv88c7kmqmb8g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cphm1o72cjh2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z026751atk3ki1equk553kjtv4clm0rmauhjcjuo_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cphm1o72cjh2bs)
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmgk8f2k91v9edjgmbhtdeo8tbh2v5uhp3dsd1f8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cphm1o72cjh2bs)
What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

Limited no-risk trials now available

Click below to check if you qualify for a 45-day no-risk trial. As the Germans always say: "there's never been a better time." So do yourself a favor and don’t wait. **Get started today.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfid09l762fmdhlf8i1crc1oh0798drg9l28cvp8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cpjm0or2cdh2bs)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhj8ln5sgju2lda6o635ejllb35evta4vmb405lg_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cpjm0or2cdh2bs)
What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

# Your Voice Counts: Go Vote!
---
Voting is one of the most empowering things you can do as a citizen. It's your chance to say, "This is the world I want!" Plus, it's your right--a right that took hundreds of years to establish in America.
Let's take a quick look back: When the United States began, voting rights were very limited. In the late 1700s, voting was generally reserved for white men who owned property. But over the next two centuries, Americans pushed to make voting more inclusive. In 1870, the 15th Amendment ensured voting rights regardless of race (in theory, anyway). Then, in 1920, the 19th Amendment gave women the right to vote. The Civil Rights Movement in the 1960s, including the Voting Rights Act of 1965, addressed many barriers that had kept people of color from voting. Finally, in 1971, the voting age was lowered to 18--meaning that even college students could say, "Yes, my voice matters!"
Voting isn't just a tradition; it's a celebration of democracy and progress! Each vote is like casting a wish for the future you want to see. And, hey, don't worry if it feels like your one vote is small--drop by drop, votes build a flood of change.
We have an amazing privilege to select the people who will represent us. I was deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan, where I watched as people who had never been able to vote lined up for blocks for their turn to vote. In that spirit, I hope you will take the time to make your voice heard.
So, grab your "I Voted" sticker, and join in! It's a few minutes of your day to influence the future. Mark IT IS TIME FOR A CHANGE!
*******

VOTE!!!

## Biden Tries to Clean Up 'Garbage' Remark
The Biden administration continued its efforts to clarify [President Biden’s remarks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQRb_G7ohgwNgUFK9Jl9duaY1hcGaFjYVJovz9KttveXWlo6PzdZtvyJn39T9u5FsqM0gwQkmh1RyR83s2ffSJCEj35NWopR6lm6C_e4vBkHUjakPOLqgDwmCsi3aAMDjTs__QlNRKSVAKLjClYRqtjZSsTuQ6IylyK_XyXXhvd0r5XZ5UL6Fsffb31o6z0_86uHZwxWOn1_m5PqM2Dpk6uC4caRetPrZDnI_jKLVRPcWKdcGVxPGg2oqoHIoIZeMgyEIIySk5LSgDTlERWWeSU2gnO1JffTxenDOfduyMXDfk_GvU_ir09PATAAD__83EaBY) on Tuesday where he called supporters of former President Trump “garbage” during a call with Voto Latino. Press secretary Karine Jean-Pierre [fielded several questions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO6yAQQNGvgc7RMBCwC4rXuMtrt7RwGOxZYWNhkih_v8r2W1_pFPfrNt0CZ96X_2Ej31KZENB0Cjqtphg4vycjo09ESFqSV06DdjD0KFc_oHIQrQ6G-nRVNrmBgAIYF-cYg5XsP5oCrRSgUnjBPl17Z22kZHWiQRigyK3Uy3fhva2U8rs8qV7uZZPZr60dp9D_BI4Cx7bSyjl_msBxLRvt9DoFjvewHYGXXeBoBotXhG7mSHvX6mM7uvNxHKU2qme3hDqHhQSOsvp4vDhnPq0TBpYt8C8t218bnh5_AgAA__8FqF8l) at Wednesday’s briefing, stating Biden was misinterpreted and that he was commenting on a joke made at Trump’s New York rally. Vice President Harris was [also questioned](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DFvwyAUBOBfgzcseLiGDAxdvKVrR4uYh_1aDBagWP73VbJ3Pt3p033f57ujSGn9cjvaFvIMAgYuBVdy9o7iNQ-dtwERUHVopVZCaXEz0G3WaPAoboP2KJTQGkxwxoDXegzLEGRH9rUmhZJSgJTQgwkfRo-jxzCqgDc2CPTUcul_MqW2YYhXfmLpl7x30W6tHZWpTwYTg-k8zz49loRnfeUMpiNHarRUBtObjRGXRjkxmH7d7qLjmyuFKq_uqry2ktMaL-6purUgVr6UV5_qzg_MR0T-cBU9f-aGvCzJSW2EVF2x_jgpRqqjZoNYd0fxTWz_Xfa08BcAAP__PJZvgQ) about Biden’s characterization of Trump supporters and said she was against, “any criticism of people based on who they voted for." In response to Biden's comments, Trump introduced a new vehicle to his motorcade in Green Bay: [a campaign-themed garbage truck](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOozAURb_GdI7sZ4JD4WIbumy7JTL4Gt6OjRF4EmW-fpTpp71XOkc6_-7j3XPibfnrM1yNZSRFrdRKGj0Gz-k1tk1wESCYBk5bo4xV_Y2a1Vn0U4urt1NUVk8TgsdsKUAZa2DQsHvTtDJaK9KaLnSL15vtuoDYmYhetAqBazku_wtvdUVMr_LAcZlLbpJba91PYf4IGgQNdcXKKb0_QcNaMjY8T0HD7PPuedkEDW3fUU9G1uMz7_LggFMu_pj8gvc2f8ha5An-gpw4YJNzyRlbFTQ0hwv7k1Pis7OiVUv2_CNr6m9hHo6-AwAA___fCWZp). ## Supreme Court: Virginia Can Purge Registrations
The Supreme Court on Wednesday granted Virginia’s emergency request to [remove over 1,600 voter registration](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQRb8GOkf22GC7cPGadHntlsgwA5mVwcg4RPn7FdtveXWlo6Pz9RgekRNvy_-4UqhzHkCCEUoKrQaMnD6DaTHMREC6paCsltpK76B9BoM2dh7BRjcZ7UflnO796CeMaA2MLYeLpqRWSoJScAM3d872PdLc65l8YyQh11xu35m3-qQ5ffJJ5TbltU3hWet-NPpfA_cG7nHf6H1c1zVK5SlRA_fjtRdaSUz5Vao4uSy8cRRnrlREoYWPWmLlvIn9VRYSY9RoXYceAVXv0U8SQNpowHltO9uWgPubU-Kjt42Ryxo5_QrVvwKdAX4CAAD__3f5Z2E)s, aiming to prevent non-U.S. citizens from voting, and sent it to a lower appeals court for consideration. This decision reverses a federal court’s Friday order granting the U.S. Justice Department’s [request for an injunction](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0jzGOrDAQRE9jMpDdDcYEDn5CNj_dEBncnumVwch4QHP7FZtvVlKV6ul9PaaH48jb879byZaQJpDQ1krWqCbvOH6mtvI2EAFhRVb1KLGXg4HqZY3unFwGVF7q0M4dmMF1Zp5xAXSIrmJ7vymJSklQChowoTO91p6CxkCDaCV5Lik334m38qIQP-mk3CxpraJ9lbIfAv8JGAWM13U1y3xsdB13L2C8o4DxeO-ZVqqX9M6lPjk_eWNXn6lQrnOK8R5V2fr94hj50L1o5XN1HH855S_v08JPAAAA__-kNFrc) blocking Virginia’s registration purge. Justice Department lawyers argued that Virginia violated a "quiet period" before the election by moving so late to remove the names of voters it suspects aren't U.S. citizens. The Los Angeles Dodgers [won the World Series](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJy8kL1uKyEUhJ-G7bDgnOWvoLiNO9825YpdDjYJXixAtvz20aZPm3I00oy-7-OyXEIueb_-D3fyI9UFBMxcCo5yiSGX9zJP0SciIJzIS4MCjXAWppsPpLSZt2QkxmRQJ-eQUFizWR2lc1P2x5oUKKUAKeEENilrtI6UNCZybBYU86jt9FnzPm6Uyrs-qZ22ep-Kv43x6Az_MTgzOIfHTq9-VEdoI2-FGJxftZXIO7VMnccar9Q6f4f9i6jzvtVGfI2WlFKrW1cVEGRKSYEhY0msQaNhgH91NTUfH69cSu7asFlc7yGXH9zxm_6nh-8AAAD__8dVhd0) Wednesday night, beating the New York Yankees 7-6 in a come-from-behind victory filled with Yankee errors and mistakes. clean_body: Our college campuses have witnessed all sorts of protests. | | | Friend, Our college campuses have witnessed all sorts of protests. We only see the angry kids burning flags, but there is actually an army of student liberty activists doing great work, too. Instead of blocking traffic, these students are helping liberty candidates win tough races and getting pro-liberty legislation passed into law. No, these aren’t overpaid consultants wasting campaign resources. These are college-aged youth trained in effective activism, making a difference by door-knocking in some of the most critical districts in the country, and they are delivering major success. I’m talking about Young Americans for Liberty’s Operation Win at the Door. Before I tell you their success rate, please let me explain why it is critical - especially today - to support them in 2024. Alright, now here are the stats showing you how successful these student door knockers are: Since 2018, YAL-recruited student activists have helped elect 328 liberty legislators who have passed over 500 pro-liberty bills. In 2020, YAL-trained student activists helped pro-liberty candidates win races in 72 Counties that Biden carried. YAL-recruited student door knockers have helped elect 66 legislators who were outspent by their opponents. It’s more powerful than money! YAL-trained activists helped secure 128 Wins with margins of victory within 5%! * Independent studies prove YAL-trained door knockers help swing races by 6-15%! Here’s the truth that no one wants to admit... If YAL’s Operation Win at the Door is so successful, then why isn’t everyone doing this? Good question! The simple answer is it is NOT easy to pull off. Conservatives are way behind the radical left when it comes to door-to-door operations. It requires a large network of youth to mobilize such a program, and most organizations do not have access to a large pool of applicants. Most conservative consultants would rather throw money at TV advertisements instead of doing the hard work of door-knocking. However, Young Americans for Liberty is the most active and effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus. They have thousands of students already in their network from which to recruit. Thank you for supporting America and standing up for the values our country was founded on. Without your support, none of this is possible. Thank you, Vivek Ramaswamy P.S. These student door-knockers are the single biggest influence on close elections. They are swinging races by 6% to 15%. They need your support to get more boots on the ground in 2024! I’ve included a photo of some of Young Americans for Liberty’s trained door-knockers. Mary Shelley’s Gothic masterpiece Frankenstein is one of the horror genre’s most formative works, but it may have never existed if not for a playful challenge. # [Mary Shelley wrote "Frankenstein" after being challenged by Lord Byron.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm7w2d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Arts & Culture](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm7w2d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm7w2d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| M ary Shelley’s Gothic masterpiece _Frankenstein_ is one of the horror genre’s most formative works, but it may have never existed if not for a playful challenge. In 1816, Shelley — who was then unmarried and known by the surname Godwin — [vacationed](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm7w2d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) at Villa Diodati on Lake Geneva in Switzerland. She was accompanied by her future husband Percy Bysshe Shelley, her stepsister Claire Clairmont, English poet Lord Byron, and Byron’s physician John William Polidori. Weather conditions were abnormally unpleasant at the time due to the lingering effects of the eruption of Indonesia’s Mount Tambora the previous year, forcing the group to largely remain indoors. Amid the dark and frigid evenings of that “Year Without a Summer,” the weary vacationers read and debated literary works late into the night, most notably horror stories and macabre poems that seemed appropriate given the gloomy weather outside.
---
As the days progressed, Lord Byron issued a challenge to those in attendance to write a scarier, more compelling horror story than the ones they’d been reading. Polidori eagerly and immediately complied, later publishing his novella _The Vampyre_ in 1819, but Shelley struggled to find inspiration at first. That all changed after a ghoulish visage came to her one stormy night, which the author [recounted](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm7w2d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) in an 1831 preface to _Frankenstein_ , writing, “I saw the hideous phantasm of a man stretched out, and then, on the working of some powerful engine show signs of life and stir with an uneasy, half-vital motion.” Shelley began work on what became her magnum opus, and effectively “won” Lord Byron’s challenge with the publication of the 1818 novel _Frankenstein; or, the Modern Prometheus_.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm7w2d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm7w2d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Thomas Edison produced the first "Frankenstein" movie.
Though 1931’s _Frankenstein_ had a more indelible impact on pop culture, Mary Shelley’s work of horror was first adapted into moving-picture form by Thomas Edison in 1910. The film, totaling around 11 minutes in length at modern projection speed, was produced by the Edison Manufacturing Company, which brought on pioneering filmmaker J. Searle Dawley to write and direct the movie. Narratively, the [short](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=75wpena7s8v48vklmyy7sk01lb8qph1u2jxu8oi6j9rlnrwv2lpmw5wduhljwsjln9f2geibu6cxa70xyw0046afyieun7m9mofflx49ke8evpuzriot8djdkvjc98s6t1c8vjag628jf38yly1nw5a6knk8h8ahkk0nr05mxdxdcncfhpa7671lsarug7bdiylqjaaqpksz8byhb2hcecrdu1cycmw4eeigrh2z6wed6kf3u1yxrkp5qwg7bjz619sxb90764sbmkdphpytbano4qt3qasqtoe9wpm&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm7w2d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) opens with Frankenstein departing for college, where he creates a monster after discovering the mystery of life. However, the scientist regrets his experiments, and is confronted by his evil creature at home later in the film. Despite Shelley’s Gothic literary vision, Dawley was advised to focus more on the story’s mystical elements than its horrific components, as Edison was a member of the prudish National Board of Censorship at the time. This early adaptation of _Frankenstein_ was considered a lost relic for decades, until a Wisconsin man named Al Dettlaff produced a copy from his private collection in 1980.

clean_body: Mary Shelley’s Gothic masterpiece Frankenstein is one of the horror genre’s most formative works, but it may have never existed if not for a playful challenge. | M ary Shelley’s Gothic masterpiece Frankenstein is one of the horror genre’s most formative works, but it may have never existed if not for a playful challenge. In 1816, Shelley — who was then unmarried and known by the surname Godwin — at Villa Diodati on Lake Geneva in Switzerland. She was accompanied by her future husband Percy Bysshe Shelley, her stepsister Claire Clairmont, English poet Lord Byron, and Byron’s physician John William Polidori. Weather conditions were abnormally unpleasant at the time due to the lingering effects of the eruption of Indonesia’s Mount Tambora the previous year, forcing the group to largely remain indoors. Amid the dark and frigid evenings of that “Year Without a Summer,” the weary vacationers read and debated literary works late into the night, most notably horror stories and macabre poems that seemed appropriate given the gloomy weather outside. As the days progressed, Lord Byron issued a challenge to those in attendance to write a scarier, more compelling horror story than the ones they’d been reading. Polidori eagerly and immediately complied, later publishing his novella The Vampyre in 1819, but Shelley struggled to find inspiration at first. That all changed after a ghoulish visage came to her one stormy night, which the author in an 1831 preface to Frankenstein , writing, “I saw the hideous phantasm of a man stretched out, and then, on the working of some powerful engine show signs of life and stir with an uneasy, half-vital motion.” Shelley began work on what became her magnum opus, and effectively “won” Lord Byron’s challenge with the publication of the 1818 novel Frankenstein; or, the Modern Prometheus. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Mary Shelley’s age when Frankenstein was published 20 | | Year Boris Karloff portrayed Frankenstein’s monster on film 1931 | Year Boris Karloff portrayed Frankenstein’s monster on film 1931 | | Record auction price for a first-edition copy of Frankenstein $1.17 million | | Completed cantos in Lord Byron’s satirical epic poem Don Juan 16 | Completed cantos in Lord Byron’s satirical epic poem Don Juan 16 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Thomas Edison produced the first "Frankenstein" movie. Though 1931’s Frankenstein had a more indelible impact on pop culture, Mary Shelley’s work of horror was first adapted into moving-picture form by Thomas Edison in 1910. The film, totaling around 11 minutes in length at modern projection speed, was produced by the Edison Manufacturing Company, which brought on pioneering filmmaker J. Searle Dawley to write and direct the movie. Narratively, the opens with Frankenstein departing for college, where he creates a monster after discovering the mystery of life. However, the scientist regrets his experiments, and is confronted by his evil creature at home later in the film. Despite Shelley’s Gothic literary vision, Dawley was advised to focus more on the story’s mystical elements than its horrific components, as Edison was a member of the prudish National Board of Censorship at the time. This early adaptation of Frankenstein was considered a lost relic for decades, until a Wisconsin man named Al Dettlaff produced a copy from his private collection in 1980. name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: My love letter to Florida 💌
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
For me, this is personal.
| | |
---
Friend, this message is a bit on the longer side, but I hope you'll take the time to read it. **[You see, in a lot of ways, this campaign is a love letter to Florida.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96206531/509262842/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2414-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjYxMDlhMjktN2M5Ny1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=cW2ek5V04AvWLxGBQzSvANDVsQfTbXhSVOQ5bZtSx6o=)**
I can still remember the first time that I came to Florida. I was working on my master's degree and had just gotten the news that my beloved father had been killed by a criminal with a gun in Ecuador, where I was born. As I grappled with my grief, I found myself missing Ecuador more than I had in years. I missed its warmth, lush greenery, and close-knit communities that I grew up with. My older sister, Monica, knew our family was struggling, so she convinced me to visit her in Miami, where she had recently moved.
When I stepped outside of the airport, it was like stepping into another world. **It was warm, wonderfully humid, bustling with lively, diverse communities, lush, and all so, so beautifully green.** We spent the next few days visiting all of Monica's favorite places in her new city — the spots with the most beautiful views and the best cafes to get a _cafecito_. The people we met were even warmer than the weather. Everyone was welcoming, friendly, and proud to call this state their home.
I boarded my plane back to my home with a heavy heart but a new resolve. **As soon as I was able, I sold my car and moved across the country to live in a one room apartment in America.**(My mom, always my closest confidant, wasn't far behind.)
Since moving here all those years ago, I've had the privilege to build a beautiful life in the Sunshine State. **I fell in love here, found the community I had longed for, raised a family of my own, and dedicated my career to serving this state.** I've helped protect the Everglades, expanded access to health care, worked for Florida International University, and became the first South American immigrant elected to Congress, right here in Florida.
I've spent my life serving this state and getting to know the communities who call it home. But my opponent, Rick Scott, has spent his career scamming Floridians, lying to voters, and making himself richer. **He wants you to think that Florida families agree with his extreme, hateful agenda._But I can promise you, friend, that couldn't be further from the truth._**
Listen, my campaign is deeply personal because of my love for this state — and more importantly, because of what it will mean for my fellow Floridians. Rick Scott wants to sow division and undo decades of meaningful progress. He wants to destroy reproductive rights, gun safety laws, and vital public services, like Medicare and Social Security, that support millions of his constituents, including my own mother.

Florida is ready for a change — I hear it from voters every day as I travel around all 67 counties. I know this November, Floridians will choose unity, progress, and kindness over Rick Scott's extremist agenda.

But the truth is, we're up against a mega-millionaire who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time. If we're going to break through Rick Scott's lies, build unstoppable grassroots momentum, and win this critical race, I'll need your help.

**[Please, will you donate $5 (or whatever you can spare today) to help me defeat Rick Scott and give our home the leadership that we deserve? This _will_ be the year that we flip Florida blue, but only if grassroots activists like _you_ believe in my campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96206534/509262843/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2414-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjYxMDlhMjktN2M5Ny1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=cW2ek5V04AvWLxGBQzSvANDVsQfTbXhSVOQ5bZtSx6o=)**

Debbie

For
America,

Charlie

I’ll be straight with you — I’m a proud conservative. But I am doing everything in my power to defeat Donald Trump and MAGA extremism at the ballot box in November. Our democracy is more important than parties or politics.

Peter, it’s Adam Kinzinger.
You might know me as one of the only Republicans in Congress on the January 6th Committee, and one of 10 Republicans who voted to impeach Trump.
I’ll be straight with you — I’m a proud conservative. But I am doing everything in my power to defeat Donald Trump and MAGA extremism at the ballot box in November. Our democracy is more important than parties or politics.
[**That’s why I’m supporting Ruben Gallego’s Senate campaign in Arizona. Will you chip in $5 or $10 to help him take on Kari Lake and win?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241031-1-160&t=2&akid=3497%2E734936%2EpuGbzp)
[DONATE](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241031-1-160&t=3&akid=3497%2E734936%2EpuGbzp)
Ruben and I are both veterans. We were both on the floor of the House on January 6th. We both saw the consequences of the lies that Trump and Kari Lake spread in advance of that terrible day and in the years since.
Ruben and I don’t agree on everything. But I fully trust him to tell the truth, to protect our freedoms, and to work for the best interests of Arizonans and all Americans.
Kari Lake, meanwhile, is an utter fraud. She and Trump brought our democracy to the brink. If we are ever going to move forward as a country we need to make sure that extremists like her are stopped, once and for all.
[**For the sake of our democracy, will you claim a stake in this fight and donate $5 to elect Ruben Gallego? Every dollar makes a difference.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241031-1-160&t=4&akid=3497%2E734936%2EpuGbzp)
Thank you for taking a stand,
Adam

name: Tara, Miserable Cat Lady (and Witch?)
subject: Hung Cao thinks witchcraft is a problem in Virginia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hi, it’s Tara, Tim Kaine’s Virginia Finance Director.
I want to wish everyone a very happy Halloween... except Hung Cao — who I have a bone to pick with today. Here’s why:
In an interview this election cycle, Hung Cao discussed witchcraft (really) and said — with a fully straight face: “ We can’t let that happen in Virginia .”
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
First of all, this isn’t a thing.
And more importantly, witchcraft is the LEAST of our worries when we have the very real threat of Republican extremists winning on November 5th. (Does anyone have a spell to secure affordable health care, a secure democracy, and reproductive freedom? Asking for a friend.)
With Election Day just five days away , I have to ask: Will you contribute to our campaign here in Virginia to defeat Hung Cao, re-elect Tim Kaine, and send Kamala Harris to the White House — so we can focus on what really matters? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=20]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=250]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Look, it’s not lost on me how much Cao’s comments harken back to a time when society literally burned women at the stake. When zealots — including here in Virginia — accused women of performing witchcraft (often women who were healers and midwives!) and then tried thousands of women to be killed or demonized and cast out.
(By the way: as Governor, Tim Kaine actually pardoned the only Virginian who was convicted of witchcraft, Grace Sherwood, nearly 300 years after her trial.)
Just look at who Cao aligns himself with: JD Vance, Donald Trump, and extremists who are right now trying to control women’s bodies and reproductive freedoms, and even surveil pregnancies and private medical records (that’s a real part of Project 2025 — google it).
See the parallels?!
This Halloween, what should terrify us is not Wicca. It is the threat of Republican candidates who compare essential health care to the Holocaust (Cao), who want to put in place a national abortion ban and interstate travel ban (Vance), and who believe that women and girls who get abortions should be punished (Trump).
Extreme candidates like Hung Cao, JD Vance, and Donald Trump want to control and demonize women for their reproductive choices – and the policies they support are quite literally killing women in red states around the country.
There may not be a growing coven of witches here in Virginia, but there are hundreds of thousands of women who are angry that we’re still fighting to protect reproductive freedoms and bodily autonomy in 2024 – and we’re ready to cast our ballots for leaders like Tim Kaine and Kamala Harris on November 5th.
Please, this Halloween, will you chip in any amount to help us defeat extremists like Hung Cao, JD Vance, and Donald Trump and send a message that we’re not going back? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thanks so much,
-Tara
Virginia Finance Director, Team Kaine
P.S. You know I’m a cat lady — in honor of the holiday, enjoy these pics of my cats in their Halloween sweaters :)

subject: 🍂 Goodbye October, Hello Change! 🎃

body:
https://freedomva.org/ [https://freedomva.org/]
“October is a symphony of permanence and change”
-Bonaro W. Overstreet
Happy Halloween!! Aside from a good horror movie, what scares me is thinking about hardworking people who are having trouble affording their rent or their medicine. Freedom Virginia works for everyone who wants an economy that's more fair and more affordable. With just 69 days until the start of the 2025 General Assembly session, we invite you to join us in advocating for an Economic Freedom Policy Agenda that builds a Virginia where the middle class has the tools to thrive.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/IMG_5161.jpg]
Freedom Virginia meets with Teachers, Parents, and Legislators to discuss school funding issues. Pictured (from left to right): Ryan O’Toole, Julie Hedrick, Alicia Atkins, Madison Irving, Tonia Emanuel, Kelley Marlin, Tanya Simms, Del. Rodney Willett, Del. Mike Jones
This month we met with more than 20 state legislators to advocate for our agenda:
Fair Taxes: Lowering taxes for the middle class and making sure the ultra-wealthy and corporations are paying their fair share.
Prescription Drug Affordability: Capping the cost of burdensome, expensive medicines for millions of Virginians.
Paid Family & Medical Leave: Provides all Virginians with access to up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave when you have a baby or a sick loved one.
Truth in Pricing: Requiring companies to advertise the total cost of a good or service upfront, rather than adding on surprise fees at checkout.
Affordable Housing: Boosting the supply of homes and apartments while also providing assistance to consumers, especially first-time home buyers.
Affordable Child Care: Expanding access to quality, affordable child care for tens of thousands of Virginia families.
https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/642309/ [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/642309/]
The FVA Team thanks community activist Christopher Rashad Green for joining us for an incredible conversation on issues across generations.
We're excited to work alongside partner organizations, champions in the legislature, and you to move this agenda forward in 2025.
Join Us! [https://freedomva.org/]
Ryan O’Toole

[] Freedom Virginia meets with Teachers, Parents, and Legislators to discuss school funding issues. Prescription Drug Affordability: Capping the cost of burdensome, expensive medicines for millions of Virginians. Paid Family & Medical Leave: Provides all Virginians with access to up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave when you have a baby or a sick loved one. Truth in Pricing: Requiring companies to advertise the total cost of a good or service upfront, rather than adding on surprise fees at checkout. Affordable Housing: Boosting the supply of homes and apartments while also providing assistance to consumers, especially first-time home buyers. Affordable Child Care: Expanding access to quality, affordable child care for tens of thousands of Virginia families. [] The FVA Team thanks community activist Christopher Rashad Green for joining us for an incredible conversation on issues across generations. # Everyone is talking about SDI. What do you need to know?
If you haven't heard about it yet, Sonoran Desert Institute (SDI) is making waves in the world of gunsmithing education. As more people take up shooting as a hobby or for self-defense, the demand for skilled gunsmiths has increased, and SDI has played a significant role in promoting and advancing the craft of gunsmithing.
[LEARN MORE](https://link.myamericanpatriot.)
**Why the industry is talking about SDI.**
**Online learning:** With the rise of online learning in recent years, SDI has become a popular option for people interested in pursuing a career in the firearms industry. **Gun Ownership:** With increasing Second Amendment exercise, people seek programs like SDIs for education on firearm maintenance, repairs, and customization. **Unique Programs:** SDI provides distinct offerings, such as an Associate of Science in Firearms Technology Degree, catering to those seeking specialized firearms industry education. **Community Experience:** SDI has cultivated more than just a network of graduates. They've built a strong community of firearms enthusiasts, hobbyists, and professionals from all different walks of life.
[ ](https://link.myamericanpatriot.)
**THE PROGRAMS**
[ ](https://link.myamericanpatriot.) **ASSOCIATE OF SCIENCE IN FIREARMS TECHNOLOGY DEGREE** A 60-credit-hour comprehensive degree program builds a foundation for tomorrow’s firearms industry professionals.
[ ](https://link.myamericanpatriot.) **CERTIFICATE IN FIREARMS TECHNOLOGY - GUNSMITHING** A 32-credit-hour program gives students an overview of gunsmithing techniques and practices, shooting sports management, and more.
[ ](https://link.myamericanpatriot.) **CERTIFICATE IN FIREARMS TECHNOLOGY - HANDGUN SPECIALIST** A 16-credit-hour program providing a detailed exploration of revolvers, striker-fired, and hammer-fired handguns.
* * *
# If you're a gun owner looking to gain gunsmithing skills or an enthusiast looking to take your skills to the next level, Sonoran Desert Institute's programs are worth checking out.
The programs offer a comprehensive curriculum that covers everything from basic maintenance to advanced customizations and is taught by experienced instructors who know the ins and outs of the firearms industry. Best of all, the program is suitable for anyone, regardless of skill level or experience. SDI's gunsmithing programs are a fantastic way to grow your skills.
# Enrolling is Easy
Enrolling is easy and straightforward. To get started, simply complete the SDI application. The Admissions and Financial Services teams are available to guide and assist you throughout the enrollment process. Whether you have questions about the application, financial aid, or program requirements, SDI's experienced staff is ready to help you. Don't hesitate to reach out to SDI and take the first step.
[REQUEST MORE INFORMATION](https://link.myamericanpatriot.)
[](https://link.myamericanpatriot.) [](https://link.myamericanpatriot.) [](https://link.myamericanpatriot.) [](https://link.myamericanpatriot.)
Sonoran Desert Institute (SDI) is an online school that helps students learn the skills and techniques they’ll need to be successful in the firearms and unmanned technology industries. SDI is accredited by the Distance Education Accrediting Commission (DEAC).

With just 5 days left until Election Day, there is no time to waste.

-Team McCormick

**More About Dave McCormick**

[](https://click.email.davemccormickpa.com/?qs=fb001aa759132c8ee457cfb3bd6388a85c11678ac1f393217c0b7221597bbfd9ea425078501a7f798876ba4ea25648c217ecc66fc759fe59b6a77173a6d6708c)
My name is Dave McCormick and I'm running for the U.S. Senate.

I'm a seventh-generation Pennsylvanian who grew up in a small, rural town called Bloomsburg. My parents, both teachers, instilled in us the responsibility to work at a young age. Summers were spent trimming Christmas trees and baling hay. To this day, my family and I still own a working farm in Bloomsburg.

On weekends, you'd find me bussing tables at the local Magee Hotel, but my passion for football and wrestling gave me purpose and a sense of belonging. It eventually led me to West Point, where I wrestled and was co-captain of the Army wrestling team.

**My time at West Point laid the foundation of duty, honor, and country that has guided me through life ever since.** I'm a proud combat veteran, having served in the 82nd Airborne Division during the First Gulf War. Upon returning, I became a successful businessman and job creator in Pittsburgh, growing the tech company I helped run from 70 employees to over 1,000. Then, I had the great honor of serving in the highest levels of government. Afterwards, I helped lead one of the world's largest investment firms.
**I've truly lived the American Dream, and my life's journey reflects that.**
Growing up in Pennsylvania set the stage for the trajectory of the rest of my life, and I am committed to ensuring that every American, regardless of where they start, has the same opportunity to fulfill their dreams that I had growing up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. _Unfortunately, as it stands today, those dreams are at risk._

We are at a breaking point and the direction we choose to go will chart the course for the future of Pennsylvania and our country.

Time and again, America has proved resilient in the face of adversity. I have a plan and the experience to move our commonwealth forward.
**I am a battle-tested leader who is ready to fight for YOU. With Democrats holding the Senate Majority by just one seat, the significance of this Senate race will shape our future, for better or for worse.**
**[Will you join me today and help save our great commonwealth?](https://click.email.davemccormickpa.com/?qs=fb001aa759132c8ee457cfb3bd6388a85c11678ac1f393217c0b7221597bbfd9ea425078501a7f798876ba4ea25648c217ecc66fc759fe59b6a77173a6d6708c)** | [DONATE TODAY](https://click.email.davemccormickpa.com/?qs=fb001aa759132c8ee457cfb3bd6388a85c11678ac1f393217c0b7221597bbfd9ea425078501a7f798876ba4ea25648c217ecc66fc759fe59b6a77173a6d6708c)

Dave McCormick

body:
Peter,

We know the consequences of this election will impact our country for generations to come. The stakes couldn’t be any higher, so we need to be prepared for every challenge we’ll face in the next five days.

Polls indicate that Trump is chipping away at Vice President Harris’s slim lead in Minnesota. With races tightening up and down the ballot, we have to stop Trump and his Republican allies from gaining any more ground.

In the final days of this race, Trump and his cronies will pour money into outrageous attack ads and attempt to spread lies, foment hate, and create division in Minnesota. They’re willing to spend whatever it takes to turn our state red and retake the White House.

Trump and his fellow Republicans have millions of dollars at their disposal, but no amount of money can match the power of our grassroots movement.

That’s why it’s essential that we raise the remaining $9,243 we need to reach our end-of-month target and continue our critical work to keep Minnesota blue. This is the LAST end-of-month deadline before Election Day, and we can’t afford to give Trump an advantage in the final week of the race.

According to our records, you’re still eligible for Minnesota’s Political Contribution Refund (PCR) program. That means you can make a $75 donation (or $150 for couples) and receive a full refund from the state of Minnesota.

clean_body: These chambers CAN be flipped this year — find out how: | Hey Peter, I’ve seen how people have been discouraged by corrupt Republican leadership and extreme partisan gerrymandering. It makes them think that the system is rigged — that their vote doesn’t matter. Here’s what I tell them: state-level races are often won by teeny tiny margins — sometimes even by less than a vote per precinct! One vote in your neighborhood could be the vote that elects a key Democracy Defender. It could be the seat that flips a key legislature from red to blue, and helps ensure democracy works for all of us. = | = New Hampshire: The Republican-held state house is a toss-up. The Republican-held state senate is within reach. State law allows for redistricting mid-cycle, meaning a Republican trifecta could redraw its congressional map in their favor (something they’re openly planning to do).
