body:
As president of our local union, I led the strike.
_[Click here to stop receiving emails about Dan Osborn's campaign in Nebraska from us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96227455/509318359/1647001491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMGI3ZTc2Yy05MDk3LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2t03J8ckmw0YfZX9v8Pj8-c0i2NFRimP6vG8ycLjFVk=&emci=eb530da9-3f97-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=00b7e76c-9097-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=19445147)_
Hey there,
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family.
When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after.
But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96227459/509318364/92586991?refcode=em20241031am2-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=00b7e76c-9097-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMGI3ZTc2Yy05MDk3LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2t03J8ckmw0YfZX9v8Pj8-c0i2NFRimP6vG8ycLjFVk=)
It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.

I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs5rQ1nWNM

A movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os5rQ1nWNM

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

I am
enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will
only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future.

A
movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.
In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as
devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's
why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on
Presidential Selection.

By
completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as
possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand
the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we
will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can
complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using
the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63712816:s5rQ1nWNM:m:3:2627245898:AD6B17118773D15830723F8D7C17F8E7:r

Do you
think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College
works and its role in preserving free and representative
government?
YES
NO

For most
of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the
Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it
was considered essential to preserving free and representative
government.

But
today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an
attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This
movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because
of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with
a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply
don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including
the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because
of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission
on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of
Americans in all 50 states.

These
efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of
our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online
courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide
with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets
popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding
documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and
guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of
charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including
American civics) to thousands of American educators and
homeschoolers.

Your
answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will
help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to
liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this
is especially important in this critical time for America's
future.

So please
share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National
Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon
as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can
take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63712816:s5rQ1nWNM:m:3:2627245898:AD6B17118773D15830723F8D7C17F8E7:r

And after
you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting
Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since
1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty."
Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach
efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government
funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state
student grants or loans.

The
support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please
represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential
Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for
your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter, it’s a scary time of year... but for most people the scariest thing this year has been their grocery bills! Or their utility bills. Or the ever increasing costs for life’s necessities due to Biden-Harris policies. So it brings up the question: “are you better off than you were 4 years ago?”. The answer for the majority of Americans & Oklahomans is unfortunately that they are NOT better off now. But there is a solution to that problem & it is very simple: vote Republican straight party on your ballot. When you go to vote this election, simply choose “Republican.”
Early voting is happing NOW through Saturday in Oklahoma. [Click here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=wM4juC3s27v2X_v1YR_CkJQV7jg8laevmHXL9LvpItYPgPRPFIArNzpc8T9ZT3Pb&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_what_s_the_scariest_thing_th&n=2) to find out where you can vote, between 8:00 am - 6:00 pm today, Tomorrow and 8:00 am - 2:00 pm on Saturday. We’ve all felt the results of President Trump’s first term with a booming economy, tax cuts for all, more energy production, & lower grocery bills. And we can compare that to the disastrous 4 years under Biden-Harris. We can return to the good times once again by voting Republican straight party on your ballot. Why is this so important beyond just the Presidential election? Well did you know that Republicans here in Oklahoma at our State Capitol eliminated the state grocery tax this year? We need solid Republicans at all levels of government who will work to make sure we keep more of our own money in our pockets AND that the dollars we do keep go further because of low prices. That’s what Republicans have done & will continue to do. So please spread the word: when filling out your ballot, simply choose Republican. We’ll keep fighting for you,
-Team OKGOP

body:
| | | Hi Peter — The election is in full swing, and millions of voters across the nation are casting their ballots to defeat Trump. There’s far too much on the line in this election—from securing our right to make decisions about our own bodies, to protecting families from mass deportations, to helping working class communities make ends meet. It’s up to us to make sure every voter turns out and every voice is heard. Let me explain: In 2020, both my dad and I voted for the very first time. For years, my dad carried his “I Voted” sticker on his phone case. He was so proud of taking action in this way, especially since voting wasn’t always something he could do. Not everyone in our communities has the opportunity to vote, and we owe it to each other and them to show up and fight for our collective futures. Growing up in a mixed-status immigrant family, I know firsthand what happens when communities stay silent or choose not to vote. It can lead to mass deportations and devastating policies like the Muslim Ban that stopped me from seeing some of my loved ones. And with MAGA Republicans and Trump back on the ballot, we can't afford to sit this out, Peter. Together, we’ve already reached more than ONE MILLION voters, but we need to mobilize even more to stop Trump and MAGA Republicans from eviscerating our rights and destroying our communities. There’s far too much on the line in this election—from securing our right to make decisions about our own bodies, to protecting families from mass deportations, to helping working class communities make ends meet. It’s up to us to make sure every voter turns out and every voice is heard. Let me explain: In 2020, both my dad and I voted for the very first time. Not everyone in our communities has the opportunity to vote, and we owe it to each other and them to show up and fight for our collective futures. Happy Halloween, Peter! Did you catch our email yesterday? We were having a little fun with the Halloween theme, but the truth is, _Mariannette Miller-Meeks really is scary. And a close second is not reaching our final end-of-month goal of this election._

clean_body: Please read before midnight: | | | Peter, tonight marks the final end-of-month deadline of this election. The polls are tightening, the attack ads are intensifying, and Donald Trump and his allies are outspending us in key battleground states. To get back on track, we set a goal to receive 236 more donations from Cresco in the next couple of hours. So, I am turning to you, Peter. You and are among my most dedicated supporters, and you understand the stakes of this election. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | I know it might seem like giving $5 or $50 with so little time left won't make a difference, but it will make a profound difference if enough of this team gives what they can. Thank you for reading, and thank you for your generous support. Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States | | | |

| Friend, We are thrilled to invite you to join Team Imer on Election Night at the Denver Marriott West in Golden, CO.
We will have a private ballroom space, a cash bar, a war room, and a room block available for attendees as the race is expected not to be called until late at night.
Any candidates for State and Federal office are invited to attend and speak.
Ticket prices start at just $15 for Gen Z attendees and $20 for Adults and General Admission. War Room access and additional ticket options are available.
We are excited to partner with our candidates and other party organizations in having this Victory Party as we watch President Trump run across the finish line on Tuesday.

**Andy Roth**

**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: | | Peter, Allow me to do away with the typical politician fundraising email charade and be transparent with you: I just want your money. It's a terrible thing to ask. Why should I be entitled to money you've worked hard to earn? It's ridiculous that our system requires candidates to beg for money 24/7. Candidates should be talking to voters and hearing what their needs are, not selling themselves to the largest bidder. The one part of this campaign that I can’t stand is asking for money. I’m running to serve and support you, not the other way around. Sadly, raising money is a necessity in our current political system. In order to beat Max Miller and Donald Trump, we need to be able to buy ad time, send mailers, and spread word about our campaign. And that takes money. This is a very tight race, and we can’t afford to fall behind on fundraising. I'm sorry to have to ask this of you. But we need all the support we can get. name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Still Time: Encourage Others to Vote for Harris
body:
Every Vote Counts | |
---
| | | Thank you for your faithful leadership supporting Harris for President and encouraging others to do the same. _**_With only five days from the election and the race too close to call, there is still time for you, as faith leaders, to influence undecided voters, as well as those who are disengaged and may not vote._**_ The latter includes **32 million regular churchgoers** , according to a [recent poll](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=e096e6ae9e&e=43463f1dee). Many of these folks would probably vote for a Republican other than Trump, and may still show up to vote for him. They are disengaged not only because they are turned off by Trump personally, but also because there is no anti-abortion candidate in the race.

_**As faith leaders, you can use your leadership and influence to encourage and equip your people to vote for Harris in these remaining days. **_You might:
* **Share why you’re voting for Harris with your congregations and communities this weekend, encourage them to vote and share Evangelicals For Harris[voting resources](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=3c3c80ad8b&e=43463f1dee)**;
* **Encourage people to vote their faith and conscience, even if it’s in the privacy of the voting booth **and they choose not to share their vote with others;
* **Watch and share our **[**Evangelicals for Harris ads**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=6ebe8d5cae&e=43463f1dee) which have been viewed over 80M times, and our “[**Hope For Harris Video Series**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=f966ff42f4&e=43463f1dee)” with leaders and regular folk telling their stories of support for Harris.
* Read, watch, and share:
* An **endorsement** [**oped**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=e583c05de3&e=43463f1dee)** in _Newsweek_ by Jerushah Duford, Billy Graham’s granddaughter**;
* 42-minute [**interview**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=a34e6f0db6&e=43463f1dee)** of Evangelicals for Harris Founder and Chair Jim Ball on _News Nation’s One Nation Under God_** ;
* A terrific piece in the [**Financial Times**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=c5b6e69f9e&e=43463f1dee)**,** one of the most esteemed news publications in the US and around the world**;**

* **Help others make their plan to vote** using [IWillVote.org](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=fe6ce6e05d&e=43463f1dee)
* **Help others vote in whatever way they need** ; for example, giving them a ride;
* [**Host a house party this weekend**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=9df5fb97a8&e=43463f1dee)** With your family and friends to encourage them to vote**; and;
* **Put up a Harris/Walz yard sign**. They make a difference!

**_“Let’s not get tired of doing good, because in time we’ll have a harvest if we don’t give up.” _**(Galatians 6:9)

For whatever ways you choose to do good by encouraging others to vote for Harris for President, thank you. As always, we’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

# Happy Halloween from Our Campaign Team! 🎃👻
---
|
Happy Halloween! 🎃 From all of us on the campaign, we hope your day is filled with lots of treats (and maybe a few tricks too!).
Beware of ghost ballots! Make sure you’re reminding friends and family to turn in theirs before Election Day!

While you’re carving pumpkins, handing out candy, or rocking that perfect costume, don’t forget—Election Day is just around the corner! 👻 But today, let’s take a moment to celebrate and enjoy some spooky fun.
Thank you for your incredible support throughout this campaign—whether it's been through donations, volunteering, or simply cheering us on. We’re so close to the finish line, and we wouldn’t be here without you.
Wishing you a fun, safe, and spook-tacular Halloween!
In solidarity,
River Gassen
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Congress, Colorado - 5
P.S. If you’re feeling extra generous this Halloween, a quick donation could help us put the final nail in the coffin this Election Day! 🎃

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Peter, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

| Dear Fellow American,

Just since I last reached out to you last week....two important election developments!

We have _sued_ Oregon for its failure to clean its voter rolls...and _a federal appeals court panel unanimously ruled in our favor in our lawsuit challenging Mississippi's reckless law "extending" Election Day_!

Our work fighting for honest elections has never been more important or more impactful!

But we still must be ready to investigate and if necessary litigate any credible allegations of voting irregularities next week!

[**Your help right now couldn't come at a more important time.**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70907&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

Thank you as always for your commitment to Judicial Watch and our mission of upholding the rule of law.

Thank you,

Tom Fitton
Judicial Watch

body:
Tonight’s end-of-month fundraising drive is our last before Election Day.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241031-1-30&t=1&akid=9340%2E3935704%2EX88NSy)
---
Hi friends,
[**Today, I’m humbly asking you to make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC before our October fundraising deadline tonight at midnight.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241031-1-30&t=2&akid=9340%2E3935704%2EX88NSy)
I know that my team and I reach out to you a lot—there’s no doubt about that. But I hope you understand that we wouldn’t make these asks if they weren’t so important.
We are just **_five days away_** from the most critical election of our lifetimes. We have the chance to maintain our slim Democratic gun safety majority in the US Senate, take back the House of Representatives, and elect Vice President Kamala Harris as the next president of the United States.
I cannot overstate the importance of this year’s election. The progress we’re going to be able to make in our gun violence prevention movement after November 5th depends on whether or not we elect leaders who will put gun safety over gun lobby profits.
GIFFORDS PAC has played a key role in this year’s elections. We’ve endorsed 342 gun safety candidates, and we’re currently running TV ads in support of our candidates in tough races. None of this would be possible without supporters like you chipping in to emails like these.
Tonight’s end-of-month fundraising drive is our last before Election Day. This is truly our last chance to build up the final resources we need to keep our ads running and fuel our final get out the vote efforts.
[**So please. We’re counting on you. Will you contribute $3 or any amount you can afford to GIFFORDS PAC today before our October fundraising drive comes to an end?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241031-1-30&t=3&akid=9340%2E3935704%2EX88NSy)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_
| | **[Donate $3](https://go.giffords.org/go/17015?c0=giffords-em-oct24.kRIcb-&amount=3&refcode=em241031-1-30&t=22&akid=9340%2E3935704%2EX88NSy)**

Dear
Fellow American,

I'm

Hillsdale College calendar.

I know, I

you're someone who cares about liberty, I wanted to make sure you
had this chance to get the 2025 calendar.

know, we live in an era of increasing bureaucratic despotism.
You've seen it, and you understand. More and more, we are ruled
by an administrative state that operates without the say of our
elected representatives.

It is,
therefore, completely unaccountable to "we the people."

This
collapse of the separation of powers has spread far beyond the
federal level into our states, our cities, and maybe even where
you live!

One
particularly disturbing example is in our K-12 schools…

At these
schools, swarms of administrators impose dangerous ideologies and
actively undermine parents.

In higher
education-especially at taxpayer-funded state
universities-bloated administrations push ideologies that teach
young Americans to disrespect or even hate their country.

But
thanks to our supporters, we remain free of this corrupting
influence. We stay true to our mission…

…to provide "sound learning" that preserves "the blessings
of civil and religious liberty."

Indeed,
as the crisis in our nation has deepened in recent years, we have
redoubled our efforts to extend this mission nationwide. But
we've only been able to do so thanks to supporters like you.

Just in
the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to…

Teach
4 million Americans in Hillsdale's free online courses, including
"Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution,"
"The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism," and our newest
course, "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism."

Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the
Constitution to citizens nationwide-especially younger Americans,
especially thousands of K-12 students.

Provide an American classical education to young students
nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence
and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, Hillsdale's monthly digest of
liberty, to more than 6.7 million households and businesses.

I hope
you'll claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar so that when
you use it next year, you'll remember how you can advance the
important work of defending liberty through education.

Remember,
your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny
of government funding-even indirectly in the form of federal or
state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY-to remain
INDEPENDENT!

Your
generosity, and that of tens of thousands of people like you,
reaches and teaches millions of Americans nationwide. You'll help
enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the
readership of Imprimis, and restore excellence to K-12 education.

show your support today by making your best tax-deductible gift

you do, you'll claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar. But

Thank you

regards,

body:
I am asking for your support one last time before Election Day.
| | | [](https://go.dscc.org/go/20489?amount=5&t=3&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20241031-KamalaHarris-HarrisLastAskTandem-Pros&refcode2=khp_em_20241031_b1_kdh_dscc_fl&refcode=DPE-FM-20241031-KamalaHarris-HarrisLastAskTandem-Pros&refcode2=khp_em_20241031_b1_kdh_dscc_fl&akid=18703%2E9716520%2EVO5LtJ)
Friend, we've gone through so much together these past few months. So I wanted to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for president ‐‐ and why your support for the DSCC and my campaign is so important to our success on Election Day in five days.

Before I continue, if you're short on time, will you split a donation between the DSCC and my campaign before our final end-of-month deadline? Here's your personal link:

[**www.dscc.org/Harris2024/#9716520**](https://go.dscc.org/go/20489?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20241031-KamalaHarris-HarrisLastAskTandem-Pros&refcode2=khp_em_20241031_b1_kdh_dscc_fl&refcode=DPE-FM-20241031-KamalaHarris-HarrisLastAskTandem-Pros&refcode2=khp_em_20241031_b1_kdh_dscc_fl&akid=18703%2E9716520%2EVO5LtJ)

**The truth is: I am no stranger to unlikely journeys.**

Where I grew up in the Bay, you either live in the hills or the flatlands. We lived in the flats. It was a working-class neighborhood of firefighters, nurses, and construction workers.

I grew up immersed in the ideals of the civil rights movement, and at a young age I decided I wanted to be a lawyer. I wanted to protect people because I believe everyone has a right to safety, dignity, and justice.

Today, my decision to run for president has everything to do with this opportunity to move past the bitterness, cynicism, and divisive battles of the past. We have the chance to chart a new way forward -- not as members of any one party or faction, but as Americans.

I want you to know that I will be a president who unites us around our highest aspirations. A president who leads and listens, who is realistic, practical, and has common sense. A president who always fights for the American people.

I cannot do it alone. No one person could. It takes a team. It takes millions and millions of people coming together at once to shape the outcome of this election and elect Democrats up and down the ballot.

body:
Tell Pechanga to Cancel Hinchcliffe Show Today | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us14.campaign-archive.com/?e=7b1b739a89&u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=1167fff96b)

| | | | |
# Hate and Bigotry Is No Laughing Matter!

Dear Friend,
I hope this message finds you well. With just five days until the election on November 5th, I feel compelled to address a deeply troubling incident involving comedian Tony Hinchcliffe, who recently made abhorrent, racist comments during a rally for Donald Trump. At this rally, Hinchcliffe attacked African Americans, Jewish Americans, Muslims Americans, Latino Americans and referred to Puerto Rico as a "floating island of garbage," a comment that not only perpetuates harmful stereotypes but also reflects a broader disdain for communities that have already faced significant challenges.
Furthermore, he made a shocking joke about Taylor Swift being assaulted and killed by her boyfriend, making light of domestic violence—a subject that is serious and should never be trivialized for entertainment. Such comments are not only deeply offensive but also perverse, and they have no place at a political rally. [_**See More Here.**_](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=6a630b0ebe&e=7b1b739a89)_****_
These remarks exemplify the toxic environment that we must actively reject. As we approach this pivotal election, it is essential that we unite against such vile rhetoric and demonstrate that we stand firmly against racism, sexism, and all forms of hate.[**I urge Pechanga Resort and the Tribal Council to take a stand by canceling Hinchcliffe’s scheduled show on December 6th. Allowing such hateful speech to continue unchecked only emboldens those who promote such intolerance.**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=a37fc3a5bf&e=7b1b739a89)[**We must all take action. I encourage you to contact their corporate lobbyist Paula Treat at (916)-300-1151**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=1055323aba&e=7b1b739a89)**to voice your concerns and advocate for the show to be cancelled.**
Let us use this election as an opportunity to reject hate and support candidates who champion inclusivity and respect for all individuals. Together, we can send a powerful message that our communities will not tolerate bigotry.
Thank you for your attention to this urgent matter.
Best regards,
Dr. Asif Mahmood

Despite claims by many Republican leaders that their policies lead to better results for working Americans, the facts reveal a starkly different reality. And it is necessary to examine these real differences in the outcomes of governance. Here I quickly break them down, with receipts, and share the impact of each party's policies on critical issues, from the economy to public safety. With the election around the corner, I hope this serves as a useful resource to send to yet uncommitted or unsure voters. You can either read below, or watch my short video that candidly breaks it down in less than 75 seconds. **Let 's Address This**.

## Crime Rates and Public Safety
While "law and order" is a frequent rallying cry among Republican leaders, the data shows a surprising contrast. [The murder rate in Republican-led states is approximately 40% higher than in Democrat-led states](https://substack.com/redirect/7a6d8253-bcfa-43f3-b926-c7f8bdbc3990?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). If blue states had this disparity, Republican leaders would likely be the first to call it out. Instead, this statistic is largely ignored in public discussions, raising questions about the actual impact of Republican-led policies on public safety.
## Economic Contributions
Republicans often promote themselves as the party of economic growth, but Democrat-led states consistently make up a larger share of America's economic output. [Blue Counties contribute a massive 71% to the nation's economy, while red Counties account for only 29%](https://substack.com/redirect/0593ec05-4d33-4165-87ae-56d1c58dd116?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Despite the rhetoric that Republican states drive American prosperity, the economic data tells a different story.
## Dependency on Federal Aid
One of the most striking differences between red and blue states lies in their reliance on federal welfare benefits. Republicans frequently criticize government "handouts," yet nine of the top ten states most dependent on federal aid are Republican-led. This reliance on federal funds raises questions about the self-sufficiency of red states and challenges the Republican stance against government assistance.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8fc1fb36-2673-45b7-af7a-065902427ef8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: https://usafacts.org/articles/which-states-rely-the-most-on-federal-aid/
## Gun Violence and Safety
Gun rights are a central tenet of the Republican platform, with many GOP leaders asserting that increased access to guns enhances public safety. However, gun violence data paints a contrasting picture. [Sixteen of the top seventeen states with the highest rates of gun violence are Republican-led](https://substack.com/redirect/cdb15db3-db8e-4112-8f9f-4294b375ab04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a troubling trend that casts doubt on the efficacy of pro-gun policies in promoting public safety.
## Maternal and Infant Health
The issue of maternal and infant mortality starkly highlights the real-world consequences of policies that deprioritize healthcare access and resources for vulnerable populations. While Republicans position themselves as the "pro-life" party, [nine of the top ten states with the highest maternal and infant mortality rates are Republican-led](https://substack.com/redirect/b84da713-20ce-44ce-bb7c-7b3dfe44575f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). These outcomes directly contradict claims that conservative policies are best for protecting life and health.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0eb4e86e-79d5-431c-8bbf-effcc18aa21b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## So, What is the GOP Really Fighting For?
The above examples could go on, and on, and on--covering education, voting access, entrepreneurship, and more. In short, the data demonstrates that Democratic-led states consistently outperform Republican-led states on key issues Republicans often claim as their own. Whether it's public safety, economic strength, reliance on federal aid, gun safety, or healthcare, the reality is clear: Democratic policies ensure better outcomes for citizens.
As voters, we have a responsibility to demand accountability. It's time to ask: what do Republican policies truly achieve outside of tax cuts for the super wealthy? And if Democratic states are already achieving the outcomes that Republicans claim to prioritize, what exactly are GOP leaders fighting for? With the election coming up, it is critical each person votes and votes to prevent Donald Trump's return to the White House. Otherwise we ensure the failure of Republican led states to further expand nationwide. While Trump and his Republican acolytes continue to fight for the billionaire class, we must reject that strategy, and instead vote to fight for the working class. The data shows that blue states are safer, more economically prosperous, and ensure better healthcare and longer lives. That is worth voting for.

clean_body: Adam might not say it, but I will. Hello, When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end. Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies. Ultimately, though, Adam lost in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country. The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money. In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we knew we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions. Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book. It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We need to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can win November 5th. But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is now a lot harder. The Super PACs are attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. If he is going to win this critical House seat, Adam needs grassroots donors like you to chip in right now: = Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = From our entire family, thank you. body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Of all the spooky and scary things on display this Halloween, there may be none scarier than what could happen if we don’t all make our voices heard in this election—and there are just a few more days left to do so. Texans can still cast ballots early today and tomorrow. [https://teamrv-mvp.sos.texas.gov/MVP/mvp.do] The next time polls will open is on Election Day, November 5!
I feel like I say this every time, but it remains true that this year’s elections are the most important we’ve ever had. The results will determine who controls the House and Senate, who resides in the White House, and so much more. Our democracy is on the line, as are our fundamental freedoms.
I’ve seen firsthand the difference in what we can do when Democrats control the House, Senate, and White House. We have all seen this year the chaos, confusion, and cruelty that characterize the current GOP-controlled House. And we don’t have to imagine what will happen if Donald Trump is successful in his effort to return to the White House—it’s all laid out in Project 2025.
We must vote and get others to vote this year with an understanding of the urgency and the stakes.
We simply have to defend this seat, win back the House, keep the Senate, and elect Vice President Kamala Harris the next President of the United States. I am optimistic that we can make it all happen because I have seen what is possible when we work together to fight for what we believe in—but we must all show up at the ballot box.
Our team is giving it our all. And in these final days, I hope you will, too.
Vote. Remind friends and family to vote. Take them to the polls. Join us to talk with voters. Make every last moment before polls close on Tuesday count.
Together, we can do anything,
Lizzie Signature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

body:

Peter,

Happy Halloween, Indiana! While the kids may be out trick-or-treating tonight, Hoosier voters have their own choice this year between fear and chaos or hope and optimism at the ballot box.

And the scariest costume you’ll see tonight isn’t nearly as scary as the candidate Indiana Republicans have nominated for the state’s second highest office: Micah Beckwith.

Beckwith has called same-sex marriage a sin and “vile”, and said the rioters on January 6 were sent by God to the U.S. Capitol. He thinks Indiana’s abortion ban doesn’t go far enough and wants to ban all abortions, even those for rape, incest, and life of the mother.

We can’t let fear and chaos paralyze the Statehouse for the next four years when there’s important issues from healthcare to education to property taxes to solve for Hoosiers.

With just five days until the most important election in our history, will you make a donation to stop Micah Beckwith and elect a new generation of Democratic leadership in Indiana? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/indems]

Thanks,
Indiana Dems

subject: Today's Deadline
body:
Husband. Father. Businessman. Proven Conservative. | | | [ ](https://judsonsapp.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=786f9905f43902655e694a1cd&id=6ef5819c4c&e=dc147d445f)
---
|
---
| _**Husband. Father. Businessman.
Proven Conservative.**_
---
|
---
| Friends,
Today at midnight is the final day to collect donations for the 2024 election for candidates on the State and Local level.

I have been humbled by the outpouring of support from so many great citizens throughout Clay, Marion, Putnam, and St. Johns Counties.

As we work to get out the vote for both my campaign and President Donald Trump, we need help from friends like you to help us sprint across the finish line.

**Please consider visiting[www.JudsonSapp.com](https://judsonsapp.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=786f9905f43902655e694a1cd&id=b7adbeff2c&e=dc147d445f) today and donating to help us finish strong.**

Let's Keep Florida Free and Make America Great Again!
_**Judson**_
---
|
---
| [DONATE](https://judsonsapp.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=786f9905f43902655e694a1cd&id=ed52ec8935&e=dc147d445f "DONATE")
---
|
---
|
---
"The citizens of Clay, Marion, Putnam, and St. Johns Counties can be assured that Judson Sapp is an America First patriot as well as an early and loyal supporter of President Donald Trump.

**Judson Sapp is a proven pro-life, pro-gun, pro-Trump conservative who will fight for the people, not special interests.**

As a man who has dedicated his life to our Nation, I commend Judson Sapp for his willingness to serve the people of his district and for his courage to stand firm on principle.

I urge all citizens of Florida’s 20th State House District to vote for Judson Sapp for State Representative." _**-General Michael Flynn**_
|
---
|
---
“**Judson Sapp is the leader Putnam County needs to continue the progress we have made.** He’s a respected businessman, a dedicated father, and a solid conservative we can count on to fight for us. As a Putnam County Commissioner, I look forward to working with Judson as our next State Representative.”
**-Putnam County Commissioner Larry Harvey**
|
---
|
---
“I am proud to endorse Judson Sapp for State Representative. Judson is a native of Northeast Florida, he runs a successful business, helps local charities, and is raising a family here. **Judson Sapp is a staunch supporter of law enforcement and understand the needs of our community.** I look forward to working with Judson as our next State Representative to preserve the Florida we all know and love.”
**-Putnam County Sheriff Gator DeLoach**
|
---
|
---
“**Judson Sapp is a leader North Florida can trust to work hard, get results, and stand firm for our conservative values.** I’m proud to endorse Judson for State Representative and look forward to working with him to keep Florida free.”
**-Florida CFO Jimmy Patronis**
|
---
|
---
“We need more genuine conservatives like Judson Sapp who know how to create prosperity for Florida families. **With his deep authentic North Florida roots, traditional values, and job creating business experience, Judson Sapp is the conservative we need.** I am proud to endorse him for the Florida House of Representatives.”
_**-State Representative Dean Black**_
|
---
|
---
“Judson Sapp is a leader who understands the unique needs of our community. **He is an unwavering conservative and a steadfast supporter of law enforcement.** I am proud to endorse Judson Sapp to be our next State Representative.”
**-Clay County Sheriff Michelle Cook**
|
---
|
---
“**I’ve known Judson Sapp all his life. Judson is a devoted husband and father, an astute businessman, a true conservative, and he will make a fine public servant.** I am honored to endorse Judson Sapp for State Representative.”
**-Congressman John Rutherford**
|
---
|
---
“The Florida House has advanced a conservative agenda of lower taxes, less regulations, empowering parents, supporting our law enforcement, and protecting our freedoms. **I know Judson Sapp will make an excellent Representative, joining me and our Republican team, to keep Florida free, safe, and even more prosperous.** ”
_**-State Representative Chuck Brannan**_
|
---
|
---
“**Judson Sapp is a man of character who has dedicated himself to making our community a better place.** He will be a consistent conservative voice in the legislature and one who will fight for us. I’m proud to endorse Judson Sapp to be our next State Representative.”
**-Clay County Superintendent David Broskie**
|
---
|
---
“As a former State Representative and State Senator, I know what it takes to lead in Tallahassee. **Judson Sapp is the very type of leader we need in the legislature to fight for lower taxes, support our law enforcement, expand school choice, and keep Florida free.** I’m proud to endorse Judson Sapp for State Representative and I look forward to working with Judson to keep North Florida the best place in America to start a business and raise a family.”
**-Congressman Aaron Bean**
| |
---
|
---
“Judson Sapp has been a leader in business and in charitable efforts throughout Northeast Florida. **He’s proven to be a tireless fighter for our first responders and our conservative values.** There is no better candidate to take the lead for us in Tallahassee than Judson Sapp and I’m proud to support him to be our next State Representative!”
**-Clay County Clerk of Court Tara Green**
|
---
|
---
“As Sheriff it’s my duty to protect the citizens of Marion County. To keep Florida safe we need strong law and order legislators who will stand up for our law enforcement officers. **Judson Sapp is a friend of law enforcement and I am proud to endorse him to be our next State Representative.** ”
**-Marion County Sheriff Billy Woods**
|
---
|
---
“To ensure Florida remains the most law enforcement friendly state in the nation, we need legislators in Tallahassee who strongly support our men and women in law enforcement. **Judson Sapp is a solid leader we can count on to fight for our values, stand up for law and order, and represent Northeast Florida.** I am proud to support Judson Sapp to be the next State Representative from District 20.” **-St. Johns County Sheriff Rob Hardwick**
|
---
|
---
“I’m proud to endorse Judson Sapp for State Representative. **He understands the needs of our community and will work for the people, not the special interests.** There is no one better to represent us in Tallahassee than Judson Sapp.”
**-Clay County School Board Member Beth Clark**
|
---
|
---
“**Judson Sapp is the leader we need in Tallahassee to stand up for parents and taxpayers.** He’ll put Florida first and never back down to special interests. We can count on Judson to fight for what’s right.”
**-Clay County School Board Member Erin Skipper**

name: PragerU
subject: Did you hear what Google did?
body:
TheFederalistWire.com

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

In case you missed it, Google recently removed the PragerU app
from the Play Store without warning. Only after our app
disappeared from Google's platform did they bother to notify us
that it had been suspended and removed indefinitely for
"Violation of Hate Speech."

Stand Up to Big Tech

In the email from Google, they said our app contained "content
or speech asserting that a protected group is inhuman, inferior,
or worthy of being hated," referring to our recently released
short documentary, Dear Infidels: A Warning to America, which
features first-hand accounts from individuals who escaped the
oppressive grip of radical Islamic rule.

According to Google, sharing the stories of a former
Palestinian refugee, an Arab Muslim born in Israel, and brave
U.S. Navy SEALs who witnessed the horrors of Muslim extremism
constitutes "hate speech."

Dear Infidels went viral on social media, reaching millions of
people! Like clockwork, Big Tech reared its ugly head to shut us
down and suppress our reach.

We immediately jumped into action and began sounding the alarm.
Thanks to our dedicated followers and supporters, Big Tech did
NOT win, and their Soviet-style censorship tactics were thwarted.

After major outcry from our supporters and several media
outlets, Google put the PragerU app back on the Google Play
Store…for now.

Unfortunately, we know this won't be the last time we are
targeted by Big Tech giants. It is imperative that we keep
fighting for our freedoms.

At PragerU, we always fight back, but we need your help. This
is a David vs. Goliath battle. They may expect us to give up and
throw in the towel, but as long as there is breath in our lungs,
and courageous supporters like you standing beside us, we refuse
to be silenced.

Join us in the fight against Big Tech censorship with a 100%
tax-deductible donation.

Your generous tax-deductible donation will help us to keep
fighting Big Tech, expand our reach, and continue our mission to
educate and inspire Americans with the truth. Every dollar counts
in this battle for free speech and the future of our nation.

Donate now to ensure PragerU's voice remains loud and clear!

Sincerely,

Your PragerU team

| | Dear Fellow American,

I want to share with you a free video that explains the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution and how it works today.

[**It 's called "The Electoral College Explained."**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=70a3b9ee698b4e378766a561031bc2c5&_e=5cdflwCN0uxPOxS6lHWX7Mnl8ee7GZ_h5GJgJ4vhnJDxxknQxBfhSL2z2iJfExy7EcUV0nPXGmcK9icvogwISUKBMk5TJWd80s8ptHLgg13ZOmFYSFFezaRN1jtN4peUrACUgU15RekymZp_zcWHuMlwMC1F42wgzU9fsjShS6olNtXDUGj-nRmbg6yx4plZsh1w7uxxI4sidPrhe07n2Kal3QucRzzJBEZ7mQRUFpa04EeXUIQNeBqQzJ0L7y5B0emB301EMhjcxCKyAPYT7kzIVQAkPnJcQ-_7KzGqs-kujlyeXHerPsu6WANsC3yWvT7VyqH3t5Hsi-PkChzsciv0A8C5Ngf2aE7ns4hw_tQf9gzM8TeaEFHTraGoLPpQ7H0Uk4s8XrH1c16kbPTtHw%3D%3D)

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=70a3b9ee698b4e378766a561031bc2c5&_e=5cdflwCN0uxPOxS6lHWX7Mnl8ee7GZ_h5GJgJ4vhnJDxxknQxBfhSL2z2iJfExy7EcUV0nPXGmcK9icvogwISUKBMk5TJWd80s8ptHLgg13ZOmFYSFFezaRN1jtN4peUrACUgU15RekymZp_zcWHuMlwMC1F42wgzU9fsjShS6olNtXDUGj-nRmbg6yx4plZsh1w7uxxI4sidPrhe07n2Kal3QucRzzJBEZ7mQRUFpa04EeXUIQNeBqQzJ0L7y5Bhr_M2HzoDDWkC99T7OgjMGmzlQypYMjzuAiyPAJYNhtmLcRWf8UGN-Bs4kMpttMrTrIZtHmtldrhhYX65p7EEu8wFo_WPFmf0mcVFsqMo9-JAvObMs3mMLoWdBRNKJ6QC1pugenq54Q8Wbi12gfb_g%3D%3D)
Most Americans need to understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government.

But after you watch this video, you'll learn...
* Why the American Founders created the Electoral College and how the two-party system changes the way it functions

* How the Electoral College prevents political campaigns from focusing only on urban--and not rural--voters; and

* What presidential elections would look like without the Electoral College and how the national popular vote could lead to a _decrease_ in election integrity.

As you can see, this free twelve-minute video taught by Hillsdale College politics professor Kevin Portteus is packed with critical information so many Americans don't know--even patriotic Americans who love this country.

They may understand that the Electoral College is important but can't explain why.

**It 's not their fault. **

Too many schools nationwide have abandoned teaching about these important constitutional principles in favor of critical race theory, transgender ideology, or whatever Marxist ideology they dress up in some new "woke" lingo.

**But it 's _never_ too late to learn. **

After watching "The Electoral College Explained," one viewer commented on YouTube, _" This makes so much more sense now. Thanks!"_

**Here 's a link to watch the video.**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-video**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=70a3b9ee698b4e378766a561031bc2c5&_e=5cdflwCN0uxPOxS6lHWX7Mnl8ee7GZ_h5GJgJ4vhnJDxxknQxBfhSL2z2iJfExy7EcUV0nPXGmcK9icvogwISUKBMk5TJWd80s8ptHLgg13ZOmFYSFFezaRN1jtN4peUrACUgU15RekymZp_zcWHuMlwMC1F42wgzU9fsjShS6olNtXDUGj-nRmbg6yx4plZsh1w7uxxI4sidPrhe07n2Kal3QucRzzJBEZ7mQRUFpa04EeXUIQNeBqQzJ0L7y5BXRElMLPbOKkbUD4BMkyhEsveTaXrzmXsxiCuZr9joSAPWR42w7oenwNqhPPUOoLmItfAz-oEqHp8IYOtXTgK5cLPnHyZa-nSPvEjOHtu2YRV-aW_bwSey_XASkPIpfWZVrCsKLYMmqV1RE1tHoFGQw%3D%3D)

When you watch, you're guaranteed to understand everything we stand to lose if we replace the Electoral College with a national popular vote.

And when the far-Left works to keep Americans ignorant of our institutions--and why they are important--your willingness to learn is one ESSENTIAL way you'll fight for our country on the battlefield of education.

Thank you.

Warm regards,

Labin Duke, Th.M.
Associate Vice President
National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96250151/509388385/-260044646?refcode=20241031-EM-TrumpPA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjU4ZjU0MmYtYTk5Ny1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Feri5GrnictePxotV095BcebEB0lcTWZI-GHh8JAjUg=)

body:
Dear Peter,

It’s the final weekend before Election Day, and we’re stepping on the gas.

Without a doubt, this is the biggest weekend for door-knocking this year.

So, our student canvassers will be out in full force this weekend to ensure voters understand the Abortion Lobby’s extremism – if I can raise the money to make it happen.

You see, we’re over budget for deployment costs – by $25,000.

The primary reason is that inflation has pushed hotel costs through the roof. But costs for food and travel have increased too.

I’m doing everything I can to ensure students don’t have to pay out of their own pockets for this vital program.

So, would you agree to your most generous contribution to help cover costs for student deployments for this final weekend
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/DWGWYglOr99J9s3RKXNwOQ~~/AAVkMwA~

And this election season has been overwhelming.

But we can’t stop now – not so close to the finish line.

So, please help us finish strong and send a LOUD AND CLEAR message to the Abortion Goliath that we aren’t going anywhere
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/BLf9ZI01AsN5gABEJZQ8rg~~/AAVkMwA~

Your most generous contribution will help us keep momentum through November 5th(and beyond)
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/JXSJi9z1aW1thPYkaN6hdg~~/AAVkMwA~
.

Peter, good folks like you make all the difference.

So, thank you for all you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

So she signed up to volunteer, and completed her second canvassing shift just yesterday! | | 🎃 | Sarah watched the Trump rally at Madison Square Garden on Sunday. She supports Kamala Harris and DFL candidates, but she had never taken the leap to volunteering. But after watching clips from that rally, and the horrible things he and his supporters said about everyday Americans like her, she knew So she , and completed her second canvassing shift just yesterday The Minnesota DFL Coordinated Campaign is in Get Out The Vote mode, where together we are making our final outreach to voters. We have and . | For the over 20,200 volunteers who like Sarah have already signed up to , , or , thank you so incredibly much for organizing your community! If you haven't volunteered yet, we know it can feel like a big deal to even talk about politics these days, but you can make a big impact as a local Minnesota DFL volunteer like Sarah. | Reach out to your family, friends, and neighbors, and make sure they have a plan to vote. You can share that has early voting and Election Day polling locations. Share with your community on social media if you feel comfortable! Toolkit: Organize your community The most impactful organizing is when we start with our smallest circles and build connections through family, friends, and neighbors. You know your folks better than any canvasser will. And you can share with them your story about what the stakes of this election mean for you and them. Here are some resources for encouraging your family, friends, and neighbors to vote and answer questions about the Harris-Walz vision for our shared future. Make a plan to vote Voter Protection FAQ Harris-Walz policy plans Register to vote when you vote early or on Election Day | When we vote, we win. Sharing why you are voting this year with family, friends, and neighbors who are unsure about voting is the most powerful way to encourage folks to vote. Happy Halloween! Here’s something scarier than any goblin or ghoul – Project 2025.

The Heritage Foundation’s Project 2025 [https://www.mediamatters.org/heritage-foundation/guide-project-2025-extreme-right-wing-agenda-next-republican-administration] , also known as the Presidential Transition Project, is a roadmap for Trump to change American society as we know it. The 900-page plan proposes chilling policy changes that would crush working families.

https://twitter.com/CAPAction/status/1826425195831189847 [https://twitter.com/CAPAction/status/1826425195831189847]

Trump’s Project 2025 is a radical agenda to remake America. It includes:

• Halting efforts to reduce prescription drug prices;
• Dismantling workers’ rights to unionize and gutting the National Labor Relations Board;
• Restricting access to food assistance and affordable early childhood education;
• Eliminating all forms of gender-affirming care;
• Permitting the mass arrest and deportation of undocumented immigrants;
• Banning mifepristone, a medication used in almost two-thirds of all abortions;
• Reversing the progress in the fight against the climate crisis, including fossil fuel regulations and clean energy programs; and
• Replacing qualified, nonpartisan workers with Trump loyalists in federal agencies, including the Department of Justice.

And that barely begins to describe what Trump plans to do.

There’s only one solution to stop Trump and Project 2025 – we need to win at the ballot box and elect Democrats up and down the ballot.

Have a Happy Halloween, and make sure you and your friends have a plan to get out and vote on November 5, 2024.

Thank you for your support, your activism, and all that you do.

Peter We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book, ****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=b6dbc4fade4f4fe084d62afd13a5fc5d&_e=y2acuW36TtksulZBz9QNvHNEcRlgZ65pQ_636p8Z4L4c7-q46ls6Kq85axywZo-4pUFMwlbsH2Npa8iCHsNIzbnBfEmGhGDiB0_oDEBmNFAof-DvdH2Hqbbbe5SBXNx043tJEan9x0BUIXAWYpzE5hbgSNsqnnGuDVh2JtVxBZNvCABDd1xkH28nxGYPg2oiINGkJddsIVCqTxHZoB0G5QgiRVIdGqaJN-C2QU7AAcfvSwNMDRbwltCTspviz0FVO7M8efuJMko7OO8nxIRnf9MCMnT7rIFQnMl4UjVq-7AQZAIJ72Py4ggNzmsPSG6O)_

Peter, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

Hello there, it’s Ken Burns.
I’ve dedicated my life to telling America’s stories through film. Oftentimes, those stories aren’t easy. They examine moments of our country in crisis and threats to our democracy.
So, I can confidently say our country is at a crossroads, and this is the most consequential election of our lives. We are the stewards of our republic, and now more than ever, our democratic values are at stake.

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

Emily Randall for Congress

In just a few months, I’ll be closing out my 12 years in Congress.
It’s been the honor of my life to serve the people of Washington’s 6th District — and I want to do everything possible to ensure that we continue to have a committed, pragmatic, dedicated representative who shares our values.

name: DNC HQ
subject: Want to be part of THE story?
body:
---
Do you want to be part of THE story? You know which one we mean. The one where something historic happens that shifts the course of the country and everyone talks about where they were that day and what they were doing. On November 6th, you could be looking back on this moment and thinking “I did everything I could, I was making calls to voters until polls closed, knocking on doors, and helping voters get to their polling locations and vote for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz.” Election Day is just five days away. Once that day passes, there will be nothing more we can do. But, there’s an easy way to make a BIG impact in these last few days. _Getting out the vote._ With such close margins, every conversation with an undecided voter could impact the outcome of elections all over Pennsylvania. And we need your help. **Can you commit to getting out the vote at an event in your area?** | Events near: 18326 [Wrong zip code? Let us know!](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/2024_update_contact_information/?t=1&akid=2195%2E22930333%2ELnnj5O)
---
**[Knock Doors for Kamala Harris in Monroe County!](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=645465.dT1fzf&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241031_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241031_2195_do&t=2&akid=2195%2E22930333%2ELnnj5O)** Friday, November 1st, 11:00 a.m. Monroe County Office 24, Stroudsburg, PA 18360 **[RSVP HERE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=645465.dT1fzf&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241031_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241031_2195_do&t=3&akid=2195%2E22930333%2ELnnj5O)** **[Drive canvassers in Monroe County](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=705682.76_WoX&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241031_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241031_2195_do&t=2&akid=2195%2E22930333%2ELnnj5O)** Saturday, November 2nd, 11:00 a.m. Stroudsburg, PA 18360 **[RSVP HERE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=705682.76_WoX&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241031_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241031_2195_do&t=3&akid=2195%2E22930333%2ELnnj5O)** **[The Final Stretch Canvass with PA Dems in Stroudsburg!](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=713578.xnxtz7&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241031_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241031_2195_do&t=2&akid=2195%2E22930333%2ELnnj5O)** Saturday, November 2nd, 9:00 a.m. Stroudsburg, PA 18360 **[RSVP HERE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=713578.xnxtz7&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241031_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241031_2195_do&t=3&akid=2195%2E22930333%2ELnnj5O)**
**[Can't make any of these events? Find many more opportunities to get involved in your community at go.kamalaharris.com](https://ak.democrats.org/go/10703?t=4&akid=2195%2E22930333%2ELnnj5O)**
This election is going to be close. The scariest outcome is that Trump and his Republican allies down the ballot win because we didn’t talk to those last few voters. Can we count on you, Derek?
Thanks for all you do, and happy Halloween!
The Democrats

body:
| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96257208/509410645/509024324?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFlOGJmM2YxLWIxOTctZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fgfULIHDoVvlAIUMCBtaPfWI-25wJuPA9RLuTomU5O0=&emci=b22a3c95-4896-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=1e8bf3f1-b197-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=2107230) Hi Peter, Happy Halloween! Halloween is the spookiest day of the year... but nothing is scarier than not voting in this November election. I know there’s anxiety about this year’s election results. Manage those election scares and spooks by getting your ballot in by **November 5th**! The clock is ticking as there are only **5 days left** to get your voice heard. **Stay safe from all the spooks this Halloween by casting your vote early!** There are two ways to return your ballot:
1. Send it by mail! Your ballot must be postmarked on or before November 5th, and arrive at your county elections office within seven days of election day.
2. Use an [official dropbox](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96257210/509410646/719410068?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFlOGJmM2YxLWIxOTctZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fgfULIHDoVvlAIUMCBtaPfWI-25wJuPA9RLuTomU5O0=&emci=b22a3c95-4896-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=1e8bf3f1-b197-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=2107230)! Witchita Eagle: Kansas Supreme Court finds Kansans have no ‘fundamental right’ to vote [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=103124_2&amount=25]
Sit down before you read this, Team: The Kansas Supreme Court has ruled that voting is not a fundamental right protected by the Kansas Constitution.
It should go without saying, but this decision will likely weaken legal challenges to future voting restrictions in Kansas and make it easier for opponents of voting rights in their legislature to more aggressively pursue new anti-voting laws.
Hang with us while we explain how they split hairs on this decision, but -- the Kansas Supreme Court said voting is a " political right " and not a " fundamental right ". What's the difference? With a fundamental right, the government has to prove why it needs to pass new voting laws and restrictions. With a political right, the onus is on the voters to prove they are being unreasonably burdened and blocked from voting.
In short -- this decision reads like a " get out of jail free " card from Monopoly, granting a legal wink and a nudge to opponents of voting rights to make it harder to vote.
Voter suppression anywhere hurts us everywhere. Help us defend the right to vote with $25 or whatever you can today in states like Kansas where our democracy is under threat >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=103124_2&amount=25]

On Tuesday October 29, 2024 I debated Congressman Jim Himes and the Independent Party candidate Ben Wesley.
Jim Himes made false statements or lies regarding several important facts and falsely accused me of wrongdoings that were so totally false that Jim actually made a total fool of himself.
**Only a fool of a voter would vote for a fool of a congressman**
Lie #1 - Jim Himes who voted against the Violence Against Women by Illegal Aliens Act because he claimed there was no due process.
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8889f578-6e9c-41d2-8f55-c9ccab7a387e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This law which was passed in the House, despite Himes no vote, would deport illegal aliens who are convicted of committing violence against women or child abuse. (See More [Here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/abf76e3e-f93b-410f-bfe7-e10dcec608c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
Jim Himes claimed that he voted against the bill because it would result in the deportation of illegals accused of these act , not convicted, and therefore violates the 5th Amendment right of due process.
His argument is totally bogus meaning that he either lied as to why he voted against the bill or was totally unaware of the contents of the bill.
Either reason raises serious concerns regarding his competence in representing our interests in Congress.
Lie #2 - The Inflation Reduction Act Does Not Touch Medicare
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2bf2c56a-039b-4aed-933e-324efb983ece?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Jim Himes brags about how he voted for the Inflation Reduction Act. This bill is a boondoggle for green energy subsidies and totally shortchanges the residents of the 4th Districts. We do not get our fair share of the proceeds from this bill despite the fact that our district pays the largest share of income taxes compared to every other district.
**What is even worse is that $280 Billion dollars of Medicare drug savings is taken out of the Medicare to pay for $7,500 tax credits to EV owners including Teslas. (See More[Here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a51eb8dd-74e2-42d3-9a9f-01e9cbf91a15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))**
Jim Himes call this bogus. Once again he is either lying or is clueless about the content of bills that he is either voting for or against.
We should not be electing someone who is clueless about the content of bills he votes on, or lies about the content of bills.
Lie #3 - I illegally deposited dirty fill on my property.
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/53a5a41b-fe48-42cd-bc93-ad4196e30f4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Jim Himes claimed that I deposited dirty fill on my property.
The fill was clean and I spent approximately $7,500 taking samples and having it tested. These results were sent to the Town of Greenwich Wetlands agency and are in the public record. None of this fill was deposited in the wetlands and was in fact 50 feet from the wetlands.
With regard to the fill, Jim Himes also stated that I employed hundreds of illegal aliens bringing in fill and building my pool at the same time.
Himes is so off base because my pool was built in 1992 and all required building permits were obtained. Yet he lied and falsely stated that swarms of illegals miraculously appeared over 30 years later and somehow rebuilt a pool that was already there
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/70f4aa66-9a1d-424f-9605-c2b5f06ef134?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
He was silent about the massive tree cutting in wetlands by Governor Lamont which was a far more egregious act.
Incidentally the original builder of my pool was an Italian American and the fill was brought in by two small business owners, one of whom is also an Italian American. **Sorry Jim.**
As an aside, Jim also did not show up for the flag raising at Town Hall in Greenwich on Columbus Day and he and all other Democrats did not attend the Columbus Day dinner at the St Lawrence Society. All of them used to come to the event and most were in attendance last year, but not any more.
_**These lies, false statements and obvious incompetence by not knowing about the bills he votes on and his false accusations that have no basis in fact for the purpose of slandering , me, his opponent are all good reasons why he should not be re-elected.**_

name: AOC
subject: He’s talking about you.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Every day, when I walk into our nation’s capitol and through those hallowed doors, I see emblazoned on the floor of the people's House one phrase: E pluribus unum. Out of many, one.
**They want us to think it’s the other way around**. That there’s no unity in this country.
Because if we do not see ourselves in others, then they can divide us and sell our country for parts to the highest bidder and the billionaire that wants to buy us out.
We’re not going to let them do that. **We cannot let them do that**.
If we hear an individual — whether it's Donald Trump or one of his cronies on a stage — talking about our fellow Americans as a ‘pile of garbage,’ know that he’s talking about _us_. **He’s talking about _you_**.
When he calls our service members and our veterans “suckers and losers” — he’s talking about us. **He’s talking about you**.
When he talks about how he “moved on young women” like they were a “B-word” – he’s talking about us. **All of us**.
Racism is not a name or an insult, it is a descriptor of a belief system. And **Donald Trump believes that Americans are not created equal**.
So when he and the people he wants to appoint as leadership in an administration goes up on stage and echoes the words of Adolf Hitler — “an America for Americans” — he’s not talking about U.S. citizens.
**He’s talking about who he believes is loyal enough to Donald Trump**. _That’s who he believes is a citizen_.
We cannot let this happen to our country. We must defend our nation.
That is what we do when we knock on our neighbors door. That is what we do when we phonebank to a swing state. That is what we do when we donate to campaigns fighting for real progressive change — **like this one**.
[Will you make a $5 contribution today so that we can keep pushing? In solidarity,
Alexandria
