name: Tamie Wilson
subject: In honor of my aunt and survivors everywhere
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
As Domestic Violence Awareness Month comes to a close, I’m reaching out with a message close to my heart.
As a survivor of domestic violence, I know firsthand the fear, the struggle, and the pain.
But the tragedy for me didn’t end there – my beloved aunt, a vibrant, kind-hearted woman, lost her life to domestic violence.
She became part of a devastating, growing statistic that our leaders should be fighting to stop.
If we’re going to take on politicians like Jim Jordan who ignore this epidemic, I need your help to keep our campaign strong. Can you contribute $25, $50, or whatever you can today to power our campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241031_domestic_violence_link1]
I won’t lie, the reality is grim: nearly 1 in 4 women and 1 in 9 men in the United States experience severe intimate partner violence in their lifetimes.
Every year, more than 10 million people fall victim to domestic violence – an epidemic that has only been growing.
Compare that to the reality of crimes committed by immigrants and migrants, which studies show are significantly lower than crimes committed by U.S.-born citizens.
Yet while Jim Jordan, Trump, and Vance ramp up lies to demonize immigrants and paint them as violent threats, they choose to ignore the real crisis at hand – domestic violence within our own communities.
But what can we expect from abusers and abuse enablers like them?
This is a pattern: creating “threats” out of the most vulnerable while ignoring the actual, systemic violence tearing apart our families and communities.
ULTRA-MAGA figures like Jordan and Trump would rather waste time and resources on xenophobic lies than do anything to keep survivors safe, to fund protective services, or to hold abusers accountable.
They’d rather dehumanize than tackle what’s actually harming our loved ones.
So here’s to every survivor – those of us who’ve been through hell and back, who are going to defeat these men and push for a future where no one has to live in fear.
And here’s to the memory of my aunt and to every victim of this preventable violence.
We’re in the most important congressional race in the country, and we’re not slowing down. We’ve got one week left to raise every last dollar to close this out strong. Will you contribute today to finally kick these abusers and their enablers out of office? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241031_domestic_violence_link2]
Thank you for being part of this movement. Together, we’re making history – and building a future where all survivors are heard, respected, and safe.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
PS: If you can join us making phone calls, knocking on doors, or a number of other things, please sign up ASAP here. [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/]

Friend, Faith & Freedom's brand-new OPERATION BALLOT CHASE will chase the absentee or early-mail ballots of every single conservative Christian voter in every key state. And our field tests have shown that Faith & Freedom's BALLOT CHASE operations can increase Christian voter turnout by 10% to 15%! Since 2009, the Faith & Freedom Coalition has played a critical role in educating and mobilizing MILLIONS of Christian voters in every election cycle. For the 2024 Election, Faith & Freedom already has 12,500+ field staff and volunteers on the ground ... already has completed 4 MILLION Personal Home Visits ... and already has registered 5 MILLION eligible conservative Christian voters. Now, in this final sprint to Election Day, the Faith & Freedom Coalition is working around the clock on our brand-new OPERATION BALLOT CHASE operations to chase the ballots of 7 MILLION Christian voters in battleground states. The Faith & Freedom Coalition's massive "ground game" will bring together Personal Home Visits ... voter contact through phone calls and text messages ... AND high-quality voter guides to chase the ballots of 7 MILLION Christian voters. The 10% to 15% INCREASE in turnout among these 7 MILLION voters that I expect that OPERATION BALLOT CHASE will generate could mean winning every battleground state, securing a conservative majority in both the House and Senate, and even determine the outcome of the presidential race. Thank you for standing with us in this crucial moment. Your support and prayers are deeply appreciated as we work together to preserve faith and freedom in America. Dr. Ralph Reed Founder and Chairman Faith & Freedom Coalition Faith & Freedom Coalition PO Box 957736, Duluth, GA. 30095-9529

body:
Patriot,
We're just a few days away from selecting the winner of the all-expense paid trip to my December Range Day.
Did you enter for a chance to win?
It couldn't be easier: Just make a contribution at this link to my good friend Joe Kent's campaign, and every $5 you contribute will earn you a chance to win.
[https://JoeKentforCongress.com/RangeDay](https://contact.brandonherreraforcongress.com/l/6fI53a1vdu7637OWRF387YCA/DAvI0iLCk892l2f88927O59r892w/JT4lGGXiawGOJYzNeC9Q2g)
Joe has one of the toughest races in the country, one that may decide whether we have a Congress that protects the 2nd Amendment or one that treats the Constitution like it's optional.
Joe spent over twenty years serving our country in Special Forces until he lost his wife--who also served--to ISIS in Syria. He's a committed, constitutional conservative who understands the meaning of "shall not be infringed."
And he really needs your help in these final days of the election.
As a personal favor to me, I'm asking you to chip in whatever you can afford so we can get this patriot elected to Congress -- and get a chance to attend our event this December and meet Joe, me, and all your other favorite firearm YouTubers.
[https://JoeKentforCongress.com/RangeDay](https://contact.brandonherreraforcongress.com/l/6fI53a1vdu7637OWRF387YCA/DAvI0iLCk892l2f88927O59r892w/JT4lGGXiawGOJYzNeC9Q2g)
Thank you,

Terra Lawson-Remer Claims Homelessness Is Her Top Priority — But Where’s the Action? | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/792c959e4ef4/terra-lawson-remer-claims-homelessness-is-her-top-priority-but-wheres-the-action?e=784f78234b)
---
| |
---
| | | Dear Friend,
Homelessness demands real solutions, not just election-year rhetoric.
Terra Lawson-Remer has claimed it's her "top priority," yet her track record shows otherwise. During her time in office, no new county shelters were opened and, as this [Voice of San Diego article](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=fa46aa2a0e&e=784f78234b) reveals, her claims of “adding hundreds of beds” rely largely on temporary hotel vouchers and parking spots, not permanent beds or shelters. Essentially, she’s done nothing.
In addition to the lack of progress on expanding shelter access, Lawson-Remer hasn’t attended a single meeting of the very Homeless Task Force she's supposed to be actively serving on – as its vice chair. If she's not showing up to do the job she’s promised, how can she possibly claim homelessness is her priority? And how can we trust her to get the job done?
Lawson-Remer is now suddenly talking about solutions — but only because it’s election season, and she’s realized voters want real change, not empty promises. Her track record is clear: while homelessness has gotten worse, she has failed to take any meaningful action.
It’s clear San Diego County deserves a leader who delivers real results and shows up for the job. **As your next Supervisor, I’m committed to acting on homelessness with tangible solutions that actually meet the needs of our community.** I’ll force the County of San Diego to act – opening up new shelters, working with cities to row in the same direction and expanding mental health resources – all to turn lives around.
**Voting is open.** If you haven’t done so yet, remind your family and your friends why Terra Lawson-Remer isn’t an option for San Diego County. We need action on homelessness now, not tomorrow. She’s allowed things to get worse not better. Let’s get our county moving in the right direction and encourage them to vote for change this November!

clean_body: Terra Lawson-Remer Claims Homelessness Is Her Top Priority — But Where’s the Action? | | | | | | | | | | | Dear Friend, Homelessness demands real solutions, not just election-year rhetoric. Terra Lawson-Remer has claimed it's her "top priority," yet her track record shows otherwise. During her time in office, no new county shelters were opened and, as this reveals, her claims of “adding hundreds of beds” rely largely on temporary hotel vouchers and parking spots, not permanent beds or shelters. Essentially, she’s done nothing. In addition to the lack of progress on expanding shelter access, Lawson-Remer hasn’t attended a single meeting of the very Homeless Task Force she's supposed to be actively serving on – as its vice chair. If she's not showing up to do the job she’s promised, how can she possibly claim homelessness is her priority? And how can we trust her to get the job done? Lawson-Remer is now suddenly talking about solutions — but only because it’s election season, and she’s realized voters want real change, not empty promises. Her track record is clear: while homelessness has gotten worse, she has failed to take any meaningful action. It’s clear San Diego County deserves a leader who delivers real results and shows up for the job. As your next Supervisor, I’m committed to acting on homelessness with tangible solutions that actually meet the needs of our community. I’ll force the County of San Diego to act – opening up new shelters, working with cities to row in the same direction and expanding mental health resources – all to turn lives around. Voting is open. If you haven’t done so yet, remind your family and your friends why Terra Lawson-Remer isn’t an option for San Diego County. We need action on homelessness now, not tomorrow. She’s allowed things to get worse not better. subject: Across the Country: October 31st, 2024
body:
Extremists are attacking early voting ballot boxes.
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Happy Halloween and welcome back to Across the Country, our weekly series at No Dem Left Behind! We’re diving into the most pressing issues impacting the heartland of America as the 2024 election approaches. These are the stories that actually matter to our communities. Let’s stay informed, together! \- Daniela Rodriguez
---
| | | | **Early Voting Ballot Boxes**
---
|
---
Extremists have taken it too far. In three separate instances and in three different states, ballot drop off boxes were set on fire using “incendiary devices.” Among the most affected was Vancouver, Washington, with over 450 ballots damaged. Fortunately, over half of voters have been identified and contacted, **however this raises concerns about the state of our country.** There is a drastic difference between mobilizing voters and incinerating ballots to pursue an outcome. This is an abuse of our freedoms. Extremists have been ignited by hate and violence, taking for granted our sacred right to vote and have fair and free elections. **We must protect democracy at all costs!** As Harris-Walz dominates the predicted 2024 presidential polls in Washington, we must ensure every vote is honored and accounted for. The Trump years have consumed conspiracy theorists and has brought out the worst in extremists. It’s time to turn a new page— **one that will honor our voting rights, put the people first, and protect democracy.** With under a week left until November 5th, can we count on our No Dem Left Behind community to stand together and VOTE? Your vote is your voice—and our voices will be heard! Let’s keep this momentum going! Transportation to the Polls And to make sure you can get to your polling place on November 5th, we have a special discount for you! Use the Lyft code VOTE24 to arrive on time and ready to make a difference. Join us next week with Sabrina for the latest updates on nationwide breaking news. Make sure to stay informed with NDLB!
---

-Daniela Rodriguez

subject: Difficult Decision
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Kari Lake has a cash advantage on us. She’s used that advantage to outspend us in the Tucson media market, home to Arizona’s second largest metropolitan area. It’s a must win region.
#

We’ve made a difficult decision
Kari Lake has a cash advantage on us. She’s used that advantage to outspend us in the Tucson media market, home to Arizona’s second largest metropolitan area. It’s a must win region.
That spending and the attacks coming Ruben’s way have had a real impact. In the two most recent Arizona polls, Kari Lake has narrowed what was once a double digit lead to less than a point. Lake is within striking distance, and she could win.
At this stage in the campaign, we can’t let things like this go unanswered. We’ve got to fight back. But the truth is, the money to do it wasn’t in the budget. Adding additional spend ahead of our final monthly deadline with just days to raise what we need to close a new budget gap is dangerous, too.
There’s risk either way here, but we huddled as a team... and decided to give the green light.

---
| | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=44600e9ed9b54df18e079f1be1e5222e&_e=Fvs_WPxyeex7aTvFcitlfcz5p-5Rc23L_5k71AJkY8cS0YrE1SEAHdLeo8O1_0UtMDeVXQJvNniNtdnEfWrmeX694gt28WkOBZwkPmN8mpXFa9id8bwwejYQipgW-Gu1smBrMNH1j52znTyYifCYfKtHKK_6p_qrcp3lVZSp7J6xWidpp6xN9vV9-0obgcojxW21rMsARQ7nKAc5fiMntMJ4Ysce3Z0vUq7pprjCywxdFJQMGlPkqeh4NZsmQT1-apaA3MJ3XJwvhQ-qkfbf9orKvLP7YRyrovyqIZHNIyYbgEu94N8TfnjhityRtJlS_GAFqVs-836LfYNdpDssGzxsrd4ES7qHdcB6nJqm8i4Zpx-VE0g2gHaV4hRgFY-ckEd2VWsUTSvyk_hTF0I-W86qjFAgEm72UglTiE4LnMjtRO8IfYlZ5ytrueX_qtJK "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign? | | | | | Friend, There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left. "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?" Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you. There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media. I miss my family. There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to. I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing. Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out. I miss not having to send these emails. Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help. I miss my alone time! Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it. Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory. Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. # FIVE DAYS TO GO!
---
| Election Day is just five days away — if you haven’t voted yet, remember to turn in your ballot and remind your family & friends, too!
Also, please share Dr Garcia’s Video Voters’ Guide statement. It’s on YouTube [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=94234d868e&e=3ed3552a03), on Facebook [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=2f3883f6a3&e=3ed3552a03), and on Twitter [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=811decd6fe&e=3ed3552a03).
---
[](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=ae5fed60ee&e=3ed3552a03)
| You can also learn more about Dr Garcia’s positions on the major issues [on his website here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=5ff1dad99f&e=3ed3552a03).
---
|
# _Voter Information:_
---
| The Washington Secretary of State elections information page is [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=801c2db067&e=3ed3552a03).
The online Voter Guide is [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=4d6e1a18d1&e=3ed3552a03), and Dr Garcia’s Candidate Statement is [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=05b7ae29bd&e=3ed3552a03). Dr Garcia’s Video Voters’ Guide Statement is [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=98947a8fb0&e=3ed3552a03).
Registered voters can log in to the VoteWA voter portal to track their ballot and access other information [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=61bc83ed64&e=3ed3552a03).
Through Election Day, Tuesday Nov. 5, you can go in person to your county elections office and/or voting center to register to vote, update your voter registration, and turn in your ballot. A map of Voting Centers is [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=65bf18a596&e=3ed3552a03).
If you want to deposit your ballot in an official Drop Box instead of mailing it in, a map of Drop Boxes is [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=695dcf920d&e=3ed3552a03).

---
|
# Help Get Out the Vote!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | **Wave signs with us at the Seahawks game this Sunday**
Join us in Seattle before the Seahawks game this Sunday, Nov. 3, at 11:30AM to wave signs!
We’ll meet on the southeast corner of S King St & Occidental Ave S (near the old Quality Athletics bar) at 11:30AM. Hope to see you there! Contact us at [info@garciaforwa.com](mailto:info@garciaforwa.com?subject=Sign-waving%20before%20Seahawks%20game&body=) for more details.

# Donate to Help us in the Final Stretch!
---
| We are so grateful to all of you who’ve been so generous in your support. Thanks to you, we’ve been able to get Dr Garcia’s message out to the voters.
To help us reach those crucial swing voters, and people who haven’t voted yet in these last days of the campaign, [please make a donation today!](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=285285b12c&e=3ed3552a03)
[Your contribution of $5, $10, $25, $50, $100 — or whatever you can afford — will go directly towards our Get Out the Vote efforts](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=44e4f66fa0&e=3ed3552a03).

Katie will always have our backs
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39245%2E3422442%2EIL-wVS)
Derek,
From fighting for the American people as a consumer protection attorney to using her whiteboard to bring accountability to Washington, Katie has dedicated her entire career to public service.
**Since the very beginning, Katie has “done Congress” differently.** She’s helped lead the fight to ban members of Congress from trading stocks, and she’s brought her perspective as a single mom of young kids—the only one in Congress—to advocate for bringing down costs for families.
Even though Katie’s term in Congress is ending in January, she’s still hard at work for the American people. Just last month, the House unanimously passed Katie’s Electronic Permitting Modernization Act to make government work more efficiently for us. And, the Senate approved her Bottles and Breastfeeding Equipment Screening (BABES) Enhancement Act to protect new moms traveling with breastmilk.
Katie will always have our backs. We can count on her to continue to lead fights to bring transparency to our political system and to get families the help they need.

#

❗ Friends -
To everyone who wants to elect gun safety champions, please don't skip this important message.

We know you’re probably getting a LOT of emails right now, so we’ll cut to the chase: [**We're asking you to make your first online contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em2401031-2-30&t=1&akid=9345%2E3935704%2EfeWyON)

Here’s why:
This election cycle, we have endorsed 342 gun safety champions—from Vice President Kamala Harris to state legislative candidates nationwide.
Gabby and all of us here at GIFFORDS are working day in and out to get out the vote for the Harris-Walz ticket, run TV ads in battleground districts to uplift our endorsed candidates, and educate voters about gun safety.
With millions of Americans already casting ballots and Election Day just FIVE days away, we’re running out of time to reach undecided voters.

Most of our supporters don't donate—only a small fraction do. Without those donations, big or small, we wouldn’t be able to do our lifesaving work.
That’s where you come in.

| | On October 22nd, we launched our statewide Get-Out-The-Vote (GOTV) program.

Paid by New Pennsylvania Project, and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee, we're knocking on doors statewide, and connecting with our communities to mobilize them to the polls.During this GOTV, NPP proudly supports:
---
* Presidency of the U.S. - Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz
* PA Attorney General - Eugene DePasquale
* State Auditor General -State Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta
* State Treasurer - Erin McClelland
* Congress - Congreswoman Susan Wild, PA-7; Congressman Matt Cartwright, PA-8; and Janelle Stelson, PA-10.

---
By organizing and voting, Pennsylvanians can choose a future where our voices are heard, our power is respected, and our leaders put our needs ahead of themselves, and the rich and powerful.

With the election so close, we know there is a lot of information and misinformation being thrown at you, but here are the facts. **_FACT #1:_** Basic human rights are on the line in this election. We are up against millions in outside spending right now. _**FACT #3:**_ Early voting has already started. The election isn't coming up, it is here. **PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
BOO! Happy Halloween... There's a lot of spooky stuff going on this week right before the election. Make sure you're staying up to date with us on [social media](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [follow me on X/Twitter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for commentary. This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, October 31, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Ganahl: Exposing Colorado’s election failures, how citizen pressure uncovered what officials tried to hide](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
During my run as the GOP Nominee for Governor in 2022, I talked to voters across Colorado that didn’t trust our elections. 25% of Republicans didn’t vote. After the race, I decided to dig in and see if I could find a way to restore trust for voters in the process.
A month ago, I held a press conference to announce the results of that two-year investigation backed by a dedicated team of researchers. We reported that we found
shocking gaps in our so-called “gold standard” elections. [Watch it here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Over 20 well-coordinated media pieces against me were published after that, with various politicians and their paid “experts” spouting prepared statements and similar
talking points, calling me a conspiracy theorist and “reckless.”
They hoped their coordinated efforts would bury the truth, instead it backfired and exposed much more. In fact, it exposed how “reckless” some leaders of our elections have been in Colorado.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**ELECTION MUST-READS 🗳️**
[**Griswold’s office response to GOP concern lacks detail requested by Williams**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | OCTOBER 30** _In response to an inquiry made by the Colorado Republican Party, the office of secretary of state Jena Griswold claims only partial passwords to certain components of the Colorado voting systems were improperly made available in a public area of the website she manages._
__
[**USPS closes trash cans in Colorado Springs post offices to prevent election material theft**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **THE GAZETTE | STATE | OCTOBER 30** _United States Postal Service has closed trash cans inside several post offices around Colorado Springs to prevent election materials from being stolen._
[**Ballot drop-off and polling locations in Colorado**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **FOX 21 NEWS | STATE | OCTOBER 29** _Election Day 2024 is right around the corner and many voters have already filled out and mailed in or dropped off their ballots ahead of next Tuesday, Nov. 5._
|
---
**[It’s time to hold Griswold accountable](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_In a troubling development, Colorado’s Secretary of State recently confirmed that critical election system passwords were inadvertently published online, leaving sensitive data exposed for months. This exposure, according to conservative leaders, highlights severe security concerns and a failure of transparency from the Secretary’s office, prompting calls for accountability and an independent investigation._
_The released passwords, typically reserved for only a small circle of trusted state employees, were accessible to a much broader audience, including county clerks, certain county employees, and third-party vendors. These passwords, particularly for the Basic Input/Output System (BIOS), provide access to fundamental system settings, creating a potential vulnerability in Colorado’s election infrastructure. BIOS access bypasses standard operating systems, allowing control over hardware at its most basic level—a level that cybersecurity experts have long warned is susceptible to exploitation by even moderately skilled hackers._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Browning: Why voting the down-ballot is critical in 2024](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_It’s election season 2024. No one in America is unaware of that fact._
_Election news is wall to wall on every TV station, every newspaper, podcast and social media platform. The tribalism is exhausting and it’s very real._
_People have pretty much made up their minds about the top of the ticket, Team Red for Donald Trump, and Team Blue for Kamala Harris. Yet, all the discussions, energy and money are focused on that top-of-the-ticket race, even though most people have already made up their mind._
_If only people, including the media, put as much passion and energy into the down-ballot races, people might see a federal, state and local government that is more representative of their values._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Final take in 3rd District: One candidate has misled with deception, half-truths and lies; we support vote for Hurd](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Adam Frisch and the Democrats are at it again._
_In Colorado Congressional District 3, once again the Frisch campaign, in cahoots with the Colorado Democrats, is spending money and sending flyers to voters in support of a third-party candidate who can’t win._
_This time they are promoting Libertarian James Wiley, who is running in an attempt to suck votes away from Republican Jeff Hurd._
_The flyers promote Wiley as the only strong Trump supporter in the race, and mock Hurd’s long career as an attorney._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Prop. KK is a 6.5% tax on gun owners, firearm retailers that with local tax is ‘more like 30%’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Proposition KK proposes a 6.5% excise tax on firearms and ammunition in Colorado, which, when combined with other taxes, could bring the total tax on gun purchases to nearly 30%.
* Supporters argue the tax will raise funds for mental health, victim services, and school safety, while critics claim it unfairly burdens lawful gun owners and harms small businesses.
* Opponents, including local gun shop owners and Second Amendment advocates, fear the tax will drive customers to larger retailers and out-of-state options, potentially endangering Colorado’s small, family-owned gun shops.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Supreme Court allows Virginia to remove noncitizens from voter rolls before election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NATIONAL REVIEW](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The U.S. Supreme Court ruled that Virginia can remove noncitizens from its voter rolls, reversing a lower court injunction just days before the election.
* The decision supports an executive order by Virginia Governor Glenn Youngkin, aimed at ensuring that only eligible U.S. citizens vote in upcoming elections.
* Virginia officials assured that any eligible voters mistakenly removed can register on Election Day and cast a provisional ballot, which will be counted once citizenship is verified.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Copeland: Colorado’s sex-trafficking crisis, an intersection of immigration and crime](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY DR. TOM COPELAND, [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Immigration and crime are two of the top issues in this November’s election, according to polls. Where those two issues intersect tragically is sex trafficking, a $150 billion global industry._
_According to a recent investigative report by The Free Press, sex and labor trafficking of minors in the United States has more than tripled in the past four years — at least gauging by the number who have escaped slavery. That largely coincides with the opening of the southern border. Colorado is not immune to this trend._
_There is “market demand” for trafficked migrants; a recent bust in Florida arrested scores of johns, not just traffickers. Investigators with Shepherd’s Watch, a nonprofit which tracks commercial sex trends and identifies potential victims and traffickers to law enforcement, say that the volume of trafficking ads on TikTok, Facebook, and other platforms has grown dramatically in the past four years. They claim that 90% of the ads now are for migrant girls._

AP: Mississippi has a history of voter suppression. Many see signs of change as Black voters reengage [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=103124_3&amount=25]
There were a lot of reasons to be excited about last year's election results, Team, but what happened in Mississippi should give us all pause and show us why we need to fight in every state nationwide.
Mississippi has an egregious voting rights record and has the highest level of felony disenfranchisement in the country. A Jim Crow-era constitutional provision enables Mississippi to disenfranchise more than 10% of its total voting-age population and its disenfranchisement of Black voters exceeds 15% .
Mississippi has no early voting opportunities and a narrow set of qualifications for those seeking to vote absentee, meaning that the vast majority of ballots are cast on Election Day. This inaccessibility contributes to the state’s notoriously dismal voter turnout: In this year’s primary election, only 30% of those registered to vote turned out, the lowest rate since 2007.
On Election Day 2023 at least nine polling locations in the state’s most populous county — Hinds County, home of the city of Jackson — ran out of ballots multiple times throughout the day . The fight to extend polling hours became a confusing jumble of legal filings and contradicting orders all as voters waited in line -- and many left entirely due to the lack of ballots .
Also in Hinds County, opponents of voting rights in the state legislature have previously taken aim at Jackson and its over 80% Black population by creating a new court system with an unelected judge in a portion of Jackson and expanding the state-run Capitol Police force’s jurisdiction to cover the entire city rather than just a handful of government buildings.
Mississippi's playbook is clear: Disenfranchise, limit ballot access, obscure legal pathways for justice, rely on Jim Crow laws still on the books, and codify control for decades. Their endgame is power and control , not fairness or freedom.

Many see signs of change as Black voters reengage [] There were a lot of reasons to be excited about last year's election results, Team, but what happened in Mississippi should give us all pause and show us why we need to fight in every state nationwide. Mississippi has an egregious voting rights record and has the highest level of felony disenfranchisement in the country. A Jim Crow-era constitutional provision enables Mississippi to disenfranchise more than 10% of its total voting-age population and its disenfranchisement of Black voters exceeds 15% . Mississippi has no early voting opportunities and a narrow set of qualifications for those seeking to vote absentee, meaning that the vast majority of ballots are cast on Election Day. This inaccessibility contributes to the state’s notoriously dismal voter turnout: In this year’s primary election, only 30% of those registered to vote turned out, the lowest rate since 2007. On Election Day 2023 at least nine polling locations in the state’s most populous county — Hinds County, home of the city of Jackson — ran out of ballots multiple times throughout the day . The fight to extend polling hours became a confusing jumble of legal filings and contradicting orders all as voters waited in line -- and many left entirely due to the lack of ballots . Also in Hinds County, opponents of voting rights in the state legislature have previously taken aim at Jackson and its over 80% Black population by creating a new court system with an unelected judge in a portion of Jackson and expanding the state-run Capitol Police force’s jurisdiction to cover the entire city rather than just a handful of government buildings. Dear Friend,

Politics often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths. It's no wonder so many of us approach it with disdain. The endless mudslinging, pandering to special interest groups, and policies shaped by poll numbers rather than deeply held convictions make politics seem like a world Christians should avoid.

Yet, as Christians, we can't ignore the rapid unraveling of our culture or remain passive in the face of the evil we see around us. The Bible tells us that our citizenship is in heaven (Philippians 3:20) and that we are aliens and strangers in this world (1 Peter 2:11). But does that mean we should leave governing to unbelievers? Should we invest our time in influencing what seems transitory at best?

The answer is simple: Jesus commanded us to be the salt and light of the world (Matthew 5:13-14). As Christians, we are called to preserve the spiritual and moral fabric of society wherever God has placed us. And that includes influencing every aspect of our culture--entertainment, business, education, and yes, even government. | [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=6613ffb935d043b8bf848864c833013c&_e=K8ALbYGXLFGEijDHaRJSP0-oy-PhBNjfiuaPpIFD3btBqZGNWmDQh3DP03adCTHvtsCEtTEeRcBs-Y6MYeMDan0aQ_zYYqO4-uqpFR3-W5zO0bBWb-ThdvOZVmH027VwV8oN8dNiL2H4ESU9uWdeI5xNgvyIztv6qKlVlgcSjfsYTSi-G5B9i-J7gfA8QFzSbUxzjZDbX7KZaFvJ7GTS8Q9wZYj3LWAKPkg5vYJHORduUP6dg4cVgC5D30ZI-beVdwMyAJvnsHOa3ma04I5crcyFMtcdOvczo4XIv1c5s2LXNc4sRVCYwFj4x0LP8JICiV__H2kzCBaAgfXTQEWy3lSEE7iaKV9PEnNUb-R3gfm4XwYm6Sw-PuO2NWk19vWLBpmRdcP5JQf0COOa3FY2kBjMZhnnZ9m5_N5vgENGSmDj82D_Ra1USm7ztXGn-ZIe)

Here’s the deal — tonight at midnight marks my final end-of-month deadline before we officially enter the whirlwind that is GOTV, and my team tells me we still haven’t reached our $35,000 goal. If this was any other day, it wouldn’t be as big of a deal as it is right now, but that’s just the problem: fully resourcing our GOTV efforts completely relies on us hitting this goal. body:
#

Peter —
When I was in Iraq, in urban combat, we had a special knock we’d use when we were surrounded by insurgents.
The comfort in that knock was knowing that while danger was all around you, the person on the other side of the door was friendly — someone you could depend on.
I’ve never been afraid to ask for help when I needed it. And right now, I’m knocking. I’m coming to you for help, Peter.
Kari Lake is on the offense. With just a few days until voting ends, she has a resource advantage over us. She’s got more money to spend, and she is funneling all of it into a massive surge. She is ahead of us in TWO polls released in the last 48 hours. **But I refuse to let her win.**
I did not swear an oath to support and defend the Constitution to lose against someone who has spread more lies and disinformation about our elections than any other politician in the country after Trump himself. [**If you’re with me, donate $20.24.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241031-5-160&amount=20.24&t=1&akid=3503%2E734936%2ERKjlSd)
I did not lose some of my best friends in combat to cede the democracy they fought for to Trump, Lake, and the MAGA Right. This election is bigger than just who controls the House, the Senate, or the White House. It is about ensuring our democracy survives for our kids and our grandkids. [**If you’re with me, donate $20.24.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241031-5-160&amount=20.24&t=2&akid=3503%2E734936%2ERKjlSd)
In the toughest times of my life, I have been incredibly fortunate to have the support I needed to get through. My mom, my sisters, my community, my Marines. In this campaign, I have you. **And we did not come this far to lose to Kari Lake.**

We just set our biggest goal yet for our FINAL end-of-month deadline: $3 million._[Will you split a donation now between my campaign and the Ohio Dems to help us get there?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96272345/509459462/1317624361?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_Brownsplit_241031_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NWMxYjFkMy1jZTk3LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XuKIuna8BE103e0MJYXlFuafb-4286F7VzliuJxVBwQ=)_**

I know, it's a tall order, but it's not a goal we set lightly. Here's how we're going to spend this budget in this final week:

**1\. Our MASSIVE get-out-the-vote effort this weekend:** We're launching canvassing events all over Ohio to make sure voters have a plan to vote on or before Election Day.

| The California Democratic Party’s Organizing Department is excited to highlight the stories of our team members who are passionate about making a difference throughout our state. From leading our organizing efforts to connecting with local community leaders, our organizing team is working in every corner of California to ensure we continue to elect Democrats up and down the ballot.

| Cassandra Chavez is the Organizing Director for the California Democratic Party, leading the Forever Organizing team.[ Recently featured in Axios for her impactful work across California,](https://cadem.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=937cb8fef613f2c2cf80bf894&id=ecd9c28233&e=ceda8b4f9a) she is a passionate organizer dedicated to ensuring that every eligible voter receives the Party's message, has access to voting, and understands how to make a difference in their communities. A native of Fresno, California, Cassandra actively engages in grassroots organizing through door-to-door canvassing, text banking, and voter outreach.
---
| The California Democratic Party is mobilizing to engage our battleground districts! Through longterm organizing efforts, we are working tirelessly to elect people-powered leaders who truly represent the will of the people. From city council races to state assembly, senate seats, and congressional offices, our dedicated volunteers are out every day connecting with voters and emphasizing the importance of this election season. Everyday, we host phone banks, text banks, and voter outreach events to support Democrats across Northern California, the Central Valley, Antelope Valley, Santa Clarita, San Fernando Valley, Riverside County, Orange County, and beyond.

The bloodthirsty duopoly must be stopped!

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, You’ve likely heard about Rudolph Giuliani’s vile defense of genocide at Trump’s Madison Square Garden rally last weekend. The disgraced former mayor tried to justify the mass murder of Palestinian children by painting them as being brainwashed into murderous rage towards Americans at two years old! Ironically, he then waxed nostalgic about Ronald Reagan’s love of Israel while conveniently omitting that Reagan himself picked up the phone back in 1982 to demand that then Prime Minister of Israel, Menachem Begin, stop the brutal bombing of Beirut, Lebanon which resulted in an immediate ceasefire. Of course, we all know why Giuliani wants to portray innocent toddlers in such a cruel light – because he’s desperate to justify the mass slaughter that Israel has been committing for over a year by dehumanizing all Palestinians. One would think that Kamala’s team wouldn’t try to outdo Giuliani on this front, but along came former President Bill Clinton to give it his best shot.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/billboards?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_31_pm&n=1)
---
Speaking as a Harris surrogate in Michigan, Clinton started by acknowledging that the genocide is impacting Kamala’s support among Michigan’s large Muslim and Arab American community, starting with: “I understand why young Palestinians and Arab Americans think too many have died, but...” The number of dead is not yet known, but it’s believed by experts to be over 200,000. The number of people in Gaza vulnerable to death from starvation and disease from unclean water is said to be over a million! There should be no qualification to the horrific truth that “too many have died” and yet Bill Clinton was not yet finished doubling down on his defense of genocide. After evoking the attacks of October 7, 2023, Clinton suggested that no number of Palestinian deaths could ever be enough “...excuse me, I’m not keeping score that way. It isn’t how many we’ve had to kill...Hamas will force you to kill civilians if you want to defend yourself.” Peter, we can’t afford four more years of these warmongering, genocidal duopoly parties who casually dismiss the brutal killings of innocent children as a small price to pay for full spectrum dominance in the Middle East. We need to vote for an end to this madness with Stein/Ware! # Volunteer Newsletter Issue #5:
# 5 Days Till Election Day!
October 31st, 2024

|
---
| Hello Team Suozzi!
**We are less than a week away from Election Day! Now, more than ever, we need your help to make our presence felt.**
Remember that **early voting is currently going on** , if you live in Queens please click [here](https://suozziforcongress2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c0ad4a8bbd8df94a8b1718e5&id=05b0e0b056&e=2d63ff009b) to find your early vote site ([https://vote.nyc/page/find-your-poll-site](https://suozziforcongress2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c0ad4a8bbd8df94a8b1718e5&id=397e75c84c&e=2d63ff009b)), if you live in Nassau/Suffolk click [here](https://suozziforcongress2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c0ad4a8bbd8df94a8b1718e5&id=0934c6744c&e=2d63ff009b) ([https://suozziforcongress2024.com/vote/)](https://suozziforcongress2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c0ad4a8bbd8df94a8b1718e5&id=42843f22de&e=2d63ff009b).
We have many different exciting **events this weekend with the Congressman**. Please scroll below to find the event and RSVP links.
November 5th is right around the corner! Let’s keep up the strong momentum, and win this thing! Thank you all for your constant support. _Let’s Fix This_
Best,Sara Castelli

This morning, April and I were joined by a host of Congressmen, leaders in DC. Majority Leader Steve Scalise stated that my race was one of the **TOP 5 IN THE COUNTRY** that they are focusing on to keep Republican control of the House of Representatives.

It was an honor to be supported and surrounded by such a good group:

body:
| | **🎃Ready for something that’ll REALLY spook you this Halloween, Peter?

name: Andy Kim
subject: I believe a new kind of politics is possible
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for New Jersey
body:
This race is about electing a Senator we can trust. Now more than ever, New Jersey needs hard-working, principled leaders focused on the common good and injecting some integrity and civility back into our politics. **That's why I'm running for Senate.**
We're showing what is possible with a new era of politics in New Jersey. For years, New Jersey has seen politicians putting themselves and special interests ahead of the needs of families and our communities, but I believe a new kind of politics is possible.
Since we launched our campaign, thousands of grassroots Democrats have jumped in to support our movement to return this seat to the people of New Jersey. Now more than ever, we need a campaign that runs on joy and hope for the future – and that's what we intend to be for the people of New Jersey.
**But we're up against a lot. Our opponent has spent over $2 million of his vast fortune, and he's able to outspend us on the airwaves just to drown out our message.**
When control of the Senate Majority is on the line and Donald Trump is running for president, we need a senator who has a strong track record of delivering results for New Jersey in the face of MAGA Republican opposition.
Now, to keep our momentum going strong, we need your support. By standing together and continuing to support our campaign, we can overcome whatever obstacles we face in the final days of the election and win this race.
**With 5 days left in this election, can I count on you to help us sustain our momentum by pitching in whatever you can today? We're in a fight for our future, and it's a fight we're asking you to join me in.**

Now more than ever, New Jersey needs hard-working, principled leaders focused on the common good and injecting some integrity and civility back into our politics. That's why I'm running for Senate. We're showing what is possible with a new era of politics in New Jersey. For years, New Jersey has seen politicians putting themselves and special interests ahead of the needs of families and our communities, but I believe a new kind of politics is possible. Since we launched our campaign, thousands of grassroots Democrats have jumped in to support our movement to return this seat to the people of New Jersey. Now more than ever, we need a campaign that runs on joy and hope for the future – and that's what we intend to be for the people of New Jersey. But we're up against a lot. Our opponent has spent over $2 million of his vast fortune, and he's able to outspend us on the airwaves just to drown out our message. When control of the Senate Majority is on the line and Donald Trump is running for president, we need a senator who has a strong track record of delivering results for New Jersey in the face of MAGA Republican opposition. Peter,

I was just boots on the ground at the border in New Mexico, once again assessing the situation and reminding voters just _how bad_ Kamala Harris and Martin Heinrich have allowed it to become.

_Of course, “bad” is the understatement of the century._ Words and phrases like “horrifying,” “deadly,” and “worst in history” get closer to appropriate descriptions of what has happened under their watch.

And it’s not like they just _allowed_ it to happen – **they curated this disaster!**

There’s **NO WAY** we can allow Harris or Heinrich to continue failing us in Washington, D.C., and I need your help to defeat them and their radical agenda here in New Mexico.

**I am ready to get to work on DAY ONE with Pres. Trump to secure our borders and fix what the left has broken.**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Friends -
I’ve been voting for over 40 years, and my first vote was for Ronald Reagan. And in 2022, I did something I had never done before: campaigned on behalf of a Democrat, for Elissa Slotkin in her congressional campaign.
I endorsed Elissa in her race in 2022 because I had seen her work in the House, and I know that she is someone who is laser-focused on doing the right thing for the people she represents and will put service to our country over service to herself, every time.
The choice to me was clear then, and it’s even clearer now. **That’s why I am supporting Elissa Slotkin in her campaign for United States Senate in Michigan.**
The stakes in this election are unlike anything we've ever faced before. But the future of our democracy is on the line, and this is not about policy differences. It’s about doing what’s right for our country.
Donald Trump, if he is reelected with a Republican Congress, will be far more dangerous than we have ever seen before.
And if Elissa loses in Michigan, he will likely get that chance.
We have a responsibility to future generations to ensure that our republic survives. This is not just about the next four or six years—it’s about the kind of country we want to leave for our children and grandchildren.
[**If you’re ready to join me in this fight to preserve our democracy for future generations, please consider contributing $25 or more to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241031-5-900&t=3&akid=2159%2E135344%2Es6EafO)

"**Texas agrees to delay $116 billion Medicaid contract proposal,** " Dallas Morning News'**Karen Brooks Harper** -- "Texas human services officials have agreed to delay signing new Medicaid contracts until summer so lawmakers can weigh in on a proposal to force three nonprofit children's hospital plans out of the program and change coverage for 1.8 million low-income Texans.

The delay, detailed in court filings this week, temporarily halts a challenge to a [court-ordered ban](https://substack.com/redirect/f9d6ec76-fcb6-48fe-bbc3-5db3dc226758?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on new contracts that included a proposed [$116 billion overhaul](https://substack.com/redirect/61ff78d7-a1c1-4709-bf7c-61615e75f6a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for managed care organizations covering low-income Texans in the state's Medicaid STAR program and Children's Health Insurance Program.

Officials with Cook Children's Health Plan in Fort Worth, one of the nonprofits affected by the proposed changes, called the agreement good news and said they look forward to working with lawmakers "to ensure a just and equitable solution."

"As we've consistently maintained, this issue is of paramount importance, affecting thousands of children and families in many underserved communities across Texas," officials said in a written statement to The Dallas Morning News. "This is undoubtedly the right course of action. Thank you to everyone involved."

The proposed contract procurement, which emerged in March from an 18-month bidding process, would have displaced nearly half the Texans who receive Medicaid STAR and CHIP coverage from six managed care organizations across the state, switching them to new plans in late 2025.

It would have eliminated from the program health plans run for two decades by three of the state's four major nonprofit children's hospitals: Cook Children's Hospital, Driscoll Children's Hospital in Corpus Christi, and Texas Children's Hospital in Houston.

Dropping those three plans would displace about 700,000 members from their current coverage. Officials from Cook's and Driscoll have said their plans would shut down if their contracts weren't renewed. The hospitals are not in danger of closing, officials have said.

The proposed change also would displace hundreds of thousands of residents from three other plans that have operated under the program since 2012." [DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/ba4f033f-dd51-4899-a233-dbd49d2bbadc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) TOP NEWS "Texas agrees to delay $116 billion Medicaid contract proposal, " Dallas Morning News'Karen Brooks Harper -- "Texas human services officials have agreed to delay signing new Medicaid contracts until summer so lawmakers can weigh in on a proposal to force three nonprofit children's hospital plans out of the program and change coverage for 1.8 million low-income Texans. The delay, detailed in court filings this week, temporarily halts a challenge to a on new contracts that included a proposed for managed care organizations covering low-income Texans in the state's Medicaid STAR program and Children's Health Insurance Program. Officials with Cook Children's Health Plan in Fort Worth, one of the nonprofits affected by the proposed changes, called the agreement good news and said they look forward to working with lawmakers "to ensure a just and equitable solution." "As we've consistently maintained, this issue is of paramount importance, affecting thousands of children and families in many underserved communities across Texas," officials said in a written statement to The Dallas Morning News. "This is undoubtedly the right course of action. Thank you to everyone involved." The proposed contract procurement, which emerged in March from an 18-month bidding process, would have displaced nearly half the Texans who receive Medicaid STAR and CHIP coverage from six managed care organizations across the state, switching them to new plans in late 2025. It would have eliminated from the program health plans run for two decades by three of the state's four major nonprofit children's hospitals: Cook Children's Hospital, Driscoll Children's Hospital in Corpus Christi, and Texas Children's Hospital in Houston. Dropping those three plans would displace about 700,000 members from their current coverage. Officials from Cook's and Driscoll have said their plans would shut down if their contracts weren't renewed. The hospitals are not in danger of closing, officials have said. The proposed change also would displace hundreds of thousands of residents from three other plans that have operated under the program since 2012." body:
This year, Halloween gives us a chance to take a breath in the middle of an unbelievably eventful election season.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2399%2E4032634%2EcFF7zO)

Happy Halloween! I hope that your day includes plenty of treats (to be honest, mine are Mounds), zero tricks (unless they’re fun), and lots of quality time with loved ones. When my kids were little, long before the online shopping days, I’d spend days painting the perfect butterfly wings and hours stitching the perfect Spider-Man mask. I loved every minute of it. **These days, I’m on costume duty for Bailey — there might or might not be a picture of him in this year’s get-up at the end of this email.** **But first, I have to ask you something ahead of tonight’s end-of-month fundraising deadline — the last one of our campaign:** [**Will you pitch in to help hit our final monthly goal before Election Day? $28 or any amount can go a long way to help get out the vote, win this race, protect our Senate majority, and make our government work not just for the rich and powerful but for everyone.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2798?amount=28&t=8&akid=2399%2E4032634%2EcFF7zO)

This year, Halloween gives us a chance to take a breath in the middle of an unbelievably eventful election season, where the stakes are incredibly high. For our families. For our freedoms. For our democracy. But days like Halloween — where we dress up in silly costumes, eat too much candy, and make happy memories with the people we love — also remind us why we’re in this fight: to build a future where all of our kids and grandkids can thrive. (Also where all of our pets can thrive, in or out of costume — I’m working to tackle private equity greed in the veterinary industry that’s jacking up costs and putting pets in danger). If I have the honor of winning another term in the U.S. Senate next week, I will stay in the fight to ensure reproductive freedom across the country. To make universal child care a reality. To bring down the cost of housing. To tax the rich. To protect the right to vote and the right to have that vote counted. To make it easier to join a union. To root corruption out of Washington. To put power in the hands of working people. On the other hand, if Republicans take the Senate and run wild in Washington, there’d be zero opportunity to vote on a law for national abortion protections — in fact, the far right would work to ban abortion nationwide. Deep cuts to Social Security, Medicare, and education funding would be on the table. And we could see one, two, even three new right-wing extremists join the Supreme Court. Even though it can absolutely feel overwhelming to think about everything looming over us right now, I want you to remember something that Vice President Kamala Harris has been saying across the country: when we fight, we win. Channel your anxiety into action in the next five days. Deep breaths. Let’s get this done. [**If it makes sense for you right now, please make a donation of any amount to support our re-election campaign, and help make sure we win.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2798?t=15&akid=2399%2E4032634%2EcFF7zO) Happy Halloween, and thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth P.S. Now here’s a treat: Bailey, a.k.a. the Tooth Fairy, hopes you’re having a happy Halloween! | [](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2798?t=16&akid=2399%2E4032634%2EcFF7zO)

I hope that your day includes plenty of treats (to be honest, mine are Mounds), zero tricks (unless they’re fun), and lots of quality time with loved ones. When my kids were little, long before the online shopping days, I’d spend days painting the perfect butterfly wings and hours stitching the perfect Spider-Man mask. I loved every minute of it. These days, I’m on costume duty for Bailey — there might or might not be a picture of him in this year’s get-up at the end of this email. But first, I have to ask you something ahead of tonight’s end-of-month fundraising deadline — the last one of our campaign: If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | | | | This year, Halloween gives us a chance to take a breath in the middle of an unbelievably eventful election season, where the stakes are incredibly high. For our families. For our freedoms. For our democracy. But days like Halloween — where we dress up in silly costumes, eat too much candy, and make happy memories with the people we love — also remind us why we’re in this fight: to build a future where all of our kids and grandkids can thrive. (Also where all of our pets can thrive, in or out of costume — I’m working to tackle private equity greed in the veterinary industry that’s jacking up costs and putting pets in danger). If I have the honor of winning another term in the U.S. Senate next week, I will stay in the fight to ensure reproductive freedom across the country. To make universal child care a reality. To bring down the cost of housing. To tax the rich. To protect the right to vote and the right to have that vote counted. To make it easier to join a union. To root corruption out of Washington. To put power in the hands of working people. On the other hand, if Republicans take the Senate and run wild in Washington, there’d be zero opportunity to vote on a law for national abortion protections — in fact, the far right would work to ban abortion nationwide. Deep cuts to Social Security, Medicare, and education funding would be on the table. And we could see one, two, even three new right-wing extremists join the Supreme Court. Even though it can absolutely feel overwhelming to think about everything looming over us right now, I want you to remember something that Vice President Kamala Harris has been saying across the country: when we fight, we win. Channel your anxiety into action in the next five days. Deep breaths. Let’s get this done. Happy Halloween, and thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth P.S. With less than a week until Election Day, I know a lot of us are feeling a little on edge--myself included. Elections have a way of making people lose perspective, so I try to be intentional in finding ways to keep myself grounded (keep reading until the end for a picture of some of the projects I've taken on).
In this final stretch, I'm relaunching Beyond The Whiteboard to help you cut through the noise and focus your energy on the things that matter. I hope you'll learn some things and feel ready for whatever happens next.
Thanks for reading Beyond the Whiteboard! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9rYXRpZXBvcnRlcm9jLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTUxMDA3NTQ2LCJzIjoyMDUyNTY4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzMwNDE0OTEyLCJleHAiOjE3MzMwMDY5MTIsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.fMQBksXrn2Pf5ENcSCWnN5mhOz6CEIasBMQsWYxR7hk?)
So first, what have I been up to?
I'm not on the ballot this November, but I've been hard at work campaigning for candidates across California. This includes hosting fundraisers, speaking at rallies, and of course, knocking on doors.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/03a8095f-d56c-40a9-9c1c-b4e2d50d0cc9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Do you know what 's better than sitting at home and obsessing over polls? Turning off the cable news and actually talking to some voters!** Your time and energy knocking doors actually makes a difference, and I promise it's easy, low-pressure, and fun. Tomorrow, you'll get my How To Canvass tips that are sure to get you off the couch.
To find canvass opportunities, visit [mobilize.us](https://substack.com/redirect/9a084597-4d27-456b-a65f-b9aaa6cef81e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and sign up. Especially in competitive House races, like we have here in California, that aren't getting much national attention from the presidential campaigns, a last-minute surge of grassroots energy will be the push that gets our candidates over the finish line.
After you finish door knocking, make sure you're taking some time for self-care. For you, it might be a mug of hot cider and the latest edition of Beyond The Whiteboard. Personally, I've been feeling the Halloween spirit, so I made Dorothy's ruby slippers (with $10, spray glue, and glitter) for my daughter Betsy. Unfortunately, our Toto (a.k.a Poppy) is too big for the basket.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82b61f4c-a29f-464d-a0bb-9147b4e53a9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Our democracy needs you between now and November 5th to elect candidates up and down the ballot who share our values. Vote, tell your friends and family to vote, and volunteer with a campaign to canvass.
But, remember that our democracy is not just about one day; it's a season. Take care of yourself and be strong!
Katie Porter

Peter, this morning, Inside Elections upgraded our race from "Lean R" to "Tossup."
It's another sign of how different this race is from 2022.
Two years ago, no one expected our campaign to succeed. We were underestimated and counted out — and by Election Day, we had been outspent 6:1.
The odds were stacked against us. But we outperformed all expectations, coming within a percentage point of winning.
That’s because voters in AZ-06 see through Juan Ciscomani and the Republican Party. They know who orchestrated the decision to overturn Roe v. Wade — and who is blocking progress for Arizona.
Our last fundraising deadline of this race is at midnight. Will you help us win this tossup race by chipping in now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_103124_EOM_K_long_actrs]
In the last two years, we’ve seen Ciscomani walk away from a bipartisan border security bill, oppose clean energy jobs in our district, support slashing funding for Social Security, and vote repeatedly to attack abortion rights.
We’ve seen him do exactly what we expected him to do: be a puppet for the Republican Party.
Now, we need to make sure we have the resources to reach every voter in our district with our message — so we can flip this seat blue in five days.
I’m proud to have the support of Arizona leaders like Senator Mark Kelly and Attorney General Kris Mayes; of organizations like Sierra Club, End Citizens United, and Reproductive Freedom for All; and of grassroots supporters like you.
Tonight is our last fundraising deadline of this race — and we can’t afford to miss it. Will you rush a donation now to help us hit our goal and cross the finish line? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_103124_EOM_K_long_actrs]

body:
Trump Finds His Guy in Baugh, a “100% Loyal” MAGA Follower with a Record to Prove It | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/eaf1326285c5/trump-throws-his-weight-behind-baugh-the-maga-loyalist-orange-county-didnt-ask-for-18230006?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For immediate release:** October 31, 2024
**Contact:** press@davemin.com
**Trump Throws His Weight Behind Baugh – the MAGA Loyalist Orange County Didn’t Ask For**

_Trump Finds His Guy in Baugh, a “100% Loyal” MAGA Follower with a Record to Prove It

Trump’s Endorsement of Baugh Highlights Candidate’s Support for Project 2025, Refusal to Condemn January 6, and Questioning of 2020 Election Results_
**IRVINE, CA –** Today, Donald Trump made it clear who he wants in Congress to represent Orange County: Scott Baugh, a MAGA Republican who has proudly aligned himself with the Trump/ Project 2025 agenda. In a post on Truth Social, Trump called Baugh a “terrific America First candidate,” praising him as a “fighter” who would champion Trump’s radical policies. Baugh has repeatedly demonstrated his loyalty to Trump, even commending him for doing a “tremendous job” in “dismantling the administrative state.” His unwavering allegiance to Trump’s extreme, anti-government agenda is unmistakable; Baugh has gone so far as to say he stands “100% with Trump.”
---
|
---
| **“Scott Baugh has shown Orange County exactly who he is,”** said Dave Min, State Senator and Democratic candidate for California’s 47th Congressional District.**“His loyalty is with Donald Trump and the extreme MAGA agenda, not with the people of our district. Scott’s record, from refusing to recognize the legitimacy of the 2020 election results to shrugging off the insurrection of January 6, is proof he’d bring more division and partisanship to Congress, not the practical solutions we need.”**
Baugh’s Public Record on Trump and MAGA Extremism:
* [Refuses to Acknowledge the 2020 Election Results](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ae013b19c6&e=7017cc100e): Baugh repeatedly dodged questions about Joe Biden’s 2020 victory, instead choosing to pander to MAGA extremists.
* [Standing with MAGA Extremistst:](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=385cb8a8cf&e=7017cc100e) Baugh has aligned himself with Project 2025, an extreme MAGA initiative to dismantle the DOJ’s independence, giving Trump total control to wield the government as a tool for revenge against political enemies.
* [Refused to Condemn January 6th Insurrection](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=92a686bd77&e=7017cc100e): Baugh refused to condemn the violent January 6th attack on our democracy, later saying he “did not pay attention” to the January 6th Committee hearings and called them “A bit of a sham show that voters dont care about.”
* [Called Trump’s Criminal Convictions “Politically Motivated”](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c58fe34d26&e=7017cc100e): When Trump was convicted by a unanimous jury of 12 average citizens, Baugh labeled it “politically motivated,” remaining silent as Trump promises to weaponize the government against his adversaries.

In addition to Trump’s endorsement, Baugh’s record is peppered with endorsements and affiliations that raise serious concerns. Recently, [_Jewish Insider_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=775e8e2478&e=7017cc100e) reported that Baugh has supported Huntington Beach Mayor Gracey Van Der Mark, a figure known for [antisemitic rhetoric](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=f199e6d30a&e=7017cc100e) and [Holocaust denial](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=fda4a9efed&e=7017cc100e). Rather than distance himself, Baugh has campaigned alongside Van Der Mark. Baugh has dragged Orange County voters through the mud with him for decades, leaving behind a trail of corruption and scandal, including:
* **Changing voter registrations without consent:** As Chair of the Orange County Republican Party, [Baugh was at the center of a scandal where as many as 600 Orange County residents had their voter registrations changed to Republican without their knowledge](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=9cf6d7c94b&e=7017cc100e)– and led to [12 arrests](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=74eaf306ee&e=7017cc100e).
* **Indicted on more than 20 criminal charges:** In 1996, [Baugh was indicted on more than 20 criminal charges](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c262b19211&e=7017cc100e), including [four felonies](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=4c229b40a4&e=7017cc100e), for violating campaign finance laws and [persuading someone to commit perjury](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=660683ed91&e=7017cc100e). He [admitted to committing nine violations](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=a1f6ad8a95&e=7017cc100e) of the California Political Reform Act and [was forced to pay tens of thousands of dollars in fines](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ba8f17e9e3&e=7017cc100e).
* **Worked to disenfranchise voters:** Baugh was a [founding chairman](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=4eb19f2515&e=7017cc100e) of an organization that [spread voter disinformation and attempted to disenfranchise California voters](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=54b2709e54&e=7017cc100e)—long before the 2020 election.

**###**

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

# Hello Peter!
---
| Four days left until the election. In just four days, we’ll decide the future of our nation and our state. The stakes couldn’t be higher. If we lose, we’ll be represented by people who don’t believe in a woman’s right to choose, who overlook working families to protect the wealthy, and who will do everything they can to undermine our democratic processes. We can’t let that happen.
If we don’t win, the very bedrock of our democracy is at stake of eroding. But we won’t let that happen.
In these next four days, we have to mobilize like never before. We have to get out there on doors, on the phones, on social media, ensuring that every voter understands the importance of this election and just how close it is. Every vote will count, and we need everyone to vote. I need your help, more than ever, to make that happen. It will be a challenge, but I know that if we work together there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Read below to learn how you can get involved and help protect the values that define our country.
