Friend — by now, with just 5 days until Election Day, I hope you have a good sense of who I am and the issues I believe are so important.
But I thought a little reminder would be helpful, especially contrasted with who Rick Scott is 🤢. Maybe it will even motivate you to **[make a donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96278816/509480607/-1736033032?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5594-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNWZmOTg4Zi1kYzk3LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1ozxO0onOQN882HpirlfSVvvja8sxTeWUOua178erCc=)** before tonight's fundraising deadline to ensure I can defeat Rick Scott!
First and foremost, I'm everything I am today because of my mother. She brought my sisters and me to America when I was just 14\. Mom knew we had to get out of Ecuador, which was transitioning to democracy after suffering under a military dictatorship. She knew America was the key to a better life.
Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. My story is what inspires me to give back to this incredible country and state that gave me so much.
After putting myself through college, I worked for several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to **protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs.**
Rick Scott, on the other hand, banned saying the words "climate change" when he was governor of Florida, and the League of Conservation Voters gave him a whopping 0% score last year.
During my time working at Florida International University, I spearheaded a new program to **expand affordable health care access** to more Floridians. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country.
Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! In the House, I wrote the bill to **expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage** , worked with Republicans to provide **economic relief** to families and small businesses, and secured $200 million for **Everglades restoration**.
I'm proud of my record — but can Rick Scott say the same, friend? He has used his time in office writing the plan to end Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead.

Temperatures continue to drop, and Election season is at its peak — but amidst the chaos, my favorite song on the record (_and of all time_), “Love’s in Need of Love Today,” keeps me grounded in this fight. In this era of divided government and extreme partisanship, it can sometimes feel like there’s only hate. Hello, it’s Connie Schultz.
Last month, Mitch McConnell and special-interest super PACs outspent us by $40 million. This money has funded a campaign full of lies and misinformation to attack Sherrod and inflict intentional harm on others.
So, here I am, asking for your help in these final days of this campaign.
In our twenty years of marriage, I’ve heard a lot of stories about Sherrod. I’m so inspired by how many of you – in person in Ohio and in letters from across the country – have shared stories about the Sherrod you know. You talk about how smart and informed he is, but you also describe his kindness and his habit of talking less and listening more. I am so moved by your stories of how Sherrod helped this person or that family, and how the people who work for him embody the highest aspirations of public service.
Your faith in him is well-founded. The Sherrod you know is the same Sherrod our family loves. And indulge this wife, please, as I add this: Nobody knows Sherrod like I do. I know how hard he works when no one is watching, and what keeps him up at night. I am by his side on those long walks with our dogs, Franklin and Walter, as he brainstorms out loud how to help individuals in need and entire communities in crisis. I know that no matter how much Sherrod does, he always feels there is more than he could do.
**That’s the senator you know and that’s the husband I love. Thank you for your faith in him.**
[**I’m asking you to please chip in one last time with $5 or $10 – or our average donation of $26 – to keep the faith and reelect Sherrod.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96280639/509486931/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3767-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NjAzZjVkNy1lMjk3LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CUU-OfceAvuYK0fDlP3N08-40N744Ot9brwRUQ2ZbYU=)
